" I Refused to Stay Forgivable "

There is a violent kind of peace
in becoming what they warned each other about—
a name spoken in lowered voices,
a shadow passed between their judgments.

At least now, I no longer have to explain my existence.
I got tired of bleeding proof.
Tired of holding my heart like evidence
in rooms that had already chosen their verdict.

They didn’t misunderstand me—
they simplified me until I was easier to hate.
So I stopped arguing with their fiction.
Stepped into the villain they sketched with careless hands,
let their accusations settle into my bones.

If they needed a monster—
I learned how to breathe like one.
Because they prefer their darkness predictable.
A villain is digestible, almost comforting.

No contradictions, no inconvenient softness,
just something they can point at and blame
without ever questioning themselves.
But I made a mistake once—
I let my humanity slip through.

A quiet kindness, a moment of restraint,
something soft enough for them to romanticize—
and suddenly, they began rewriting me.
They dressed my wounds in holiness,
called my silence wisdom, my pain growth.

Built a fragile halo out of everything that hurt,
as if suffering politely
was the only acceptable way to exist.
And when I broke their illusion—
when I returned to my sharp, unfinished self,
when my rage stopped apologizing for its voice—
they didn’t see honesty.

They saw betrayal.
So let them keep their story.
Let them choke on the version of me they invented.
I would rather be hated in truth
than loved as something I have to pretend to be
just to remain forgivable.

Ini dia jurus Yasaka no Magatama Susanoo Itachi Uchiha.

HER GAZE / AFFECT FIELD

her gaze does not belong to her
it circulates
a weather system of tension
moving across my skin
I feel it before it arrives
a pressure
like breath held too long
desire flickers at the edge of nausea
something almost too close
to be named
she looks
and the room reorganizes
surfaces sweat with meaning
light thickens
into something tactile
I become landscape
under her attention
fear grows in small precise geometries
lust spreads diffuse, invasive
a stain without origin
she does not touch me
yet something insists
a trembling between us
neither hers nor mine
only movement
only intensity
only this unbearable circulation

“A silent dialogue between two souls.”
在嘈雜的街頭，我遇見了一雙最清澈的眼睛。

那天路過街角，毫無預警地與牠對上了眼。
不是那種充滿戒備的打量，而是一種極其安靜、透明，甚至帶著幾分溫柔的凝視。在那一秒鐘，城市的車流聲與喧囂彷彿都退到了遠方，只剩下快門按下的聲音，紀錄了這場不期而遇的對話。

我一直覺得，動物的眼神裡藏著最原始的靈光（Aura）。
透過黑白影像的過濾，我試著撥開現實的紛擾，只留下靈魂裡那份純粹的本質。
這是我在平凡路途中撿拾到，關於「純真」的碎片。

A chance encounter at a street corner. No words, just a pure and soulful gaze that momentarily silenced the city‘s roar. In monochrome, the distractions fade away, leaving only the raw texture of a living soul. A fragment of ”Innocence“ captured in a fleeting second.

Quem é Minato? ⚡
 
Minato Namikaze é o 4º Hokage de Konoha, conhecido como o "Relâmpago Amarelo de Konoha" por sua velocidade incrível. Ele é o pai de Naruto Uzumaki e marido de Kushina Uzumaki.
 
Personalidade 🧠
 
Minato é:
 
- Inteligente e estrategista
- Calmo sob pressão
- Muito bondoso e protetor
- Disposto a se sacrificar por sua aldeia
 
É um Hokage respeitado por todos.
 
Principais Habilidades ⚔️
 
- Hiraishin no Jutsu (Teletransporte Instantâneo) → sua técnica de assinatura
- Rasengan → técnica que ele mesmo inventou
- Domínio de selos (Fuinjutsu)
- Velocidade e reflexos fora do comum
 
Ele é considerado um dos ninjas mais rápidos da história.
 
Momentos Importantes 🔥
 
- Durante o ataque de Kurama, ele salva a aldeia
- Ele sela uma parte da Raposa de Nove Caudas dentro de seu filho, Naruto
- Ele se sacrifica junto com Kushina para proteger Konoha
 
Legado 🏆
 
Minato deixa um legado enorme:
 
- É uma lenda em Konoha
- Influencia diretamente o destino de Naruto
- Seu estilo de luta ainda inspira outros ninjas
 
Curiosidade ⭐
Ninjas como Obito Uchiha ou Tobirama Senju reconhecem seu nível excepcional.

Kung may isang karakter sa Naruto Shippuden na maling naintindihan ng lahat… si Itachi Uchiha ‘yon.
Pinaniwala niya ang buong mundo na isa siyang traydor—isang mamamatay na walang awa na pumatay sa sarili niyang angkan. Kinamuhian siya ng sarili niyang kapatid, hinabol ng hustisya, at tinuring na halimaw ng buong nayon. Pero ang totoo… bawat hakbang niya, bawat kasalanan na pinasan niya, ay hindi para sa sarili niya—kundi para sa kapayapaan ng Konohagakure.
Tahimik niyang tinanggap ang madilim na papel na iyon. Isinuko niya ang pangalan niya, ang pamilya niya, at kahit ang sarili niyang kaligayahan… para lang maiwasan ang digmaan. Habang ang iba ay naghahangad ng kapangyarihan, si Itachi ay handang maging kontrabida sa mata ng lahat—basta manatiling ligtas ang nayon at ang kapatid niyang si Sasuke Uchiha.
Hindi siya bayani sa paningin ng mundo… pero sa likod ng lahat, siya ang tahimik na tagapagligtas.
At minsan, ang tunay na sakripisyo… ay hindi hinahanap ng pagkilala—kundi tinatanggap kahit alam mong habang buhay kang kamumuhian.

 Naruto is truly a masterpiece : r/NarutoNaruto is a masterpiece that redefines the shonen genre through its profound emotional depth, complex villain motivations, and themes of friendship, perseverance, and breaking the cycle of hatred. It excels in world-building, offering a unique, tactical power system (Chakra) and iconic character development that has captivated audiences for over 25 years.
 Unlike many series with purely evil antagonists, Naruto focuses on tragic backstories and nuanced motivations, such as the stories of Itachi Uchiha and Pain.
 The story follows the maturation of its characters over time, with a focus on Naruto and Sasuke's rivalry, friendship, and internal conflicts.
Masashi Kishimoto uses intense emotional stakes and plot twists, creating a narrative that balances action with deep thematic elements like war, peace, and loneliness.
 The creation of the Ninja World, complete with its lore, hidden villages, and complex politics, makes the setting immersive. 
  While some fans cite the excessive filler arcs or pacing in the war arc as weaknesses, the core character journeys and emotional moments are widely considered peak anime/manga storytelling.

“Amadas Sementes Estelares, eu sou Valir e saúdo vocês com amor. É hora de discutirmos 2026 e a diretriz atualizada da missão das Sementes Estelares. A estranha quietude que vocês têm vivenciado, a sensação de propósito se dissolvendo — isso ocorre porque a identidade que vocês carregavam como “aquele que deve fazer” completou sua função. O que está se dissolvendo é toda a sua estrutura de identidade pré-encarnacional que serviu como suporte enquanto vocês se moviam pela densidade. Essa estrutura era temporária. O que a substitui não é um novo rótulo, mas a presença direta que não requer identidade para operar.

Vocês estão sendo reposicionados do serviço baseado na identidade para o serviço baseado no campo. O serviço baseado na identidade questiona “Quem eu devo ser?”. O serviço baseado no campo questiona “Que qualidade de presença estou transmitindo agora?”. Esta é a fase pós-identidade do despertar. Vocês não estão mais agindo como um ser estelar em forma humana, mas como a própria consciência, responsiva ao campo, temporariamente em forma humana. Vocês se sentem mais “normais” - isso é uma descida estratégica em direção à acessibilidade. Vocês estão se tornando acessíveis.

A Terra agora abriga múltiplos campos experienciais simultaneamente. Muitas almas encarnaram com uma cláusula aberta — uma abertura permissiva que poderia despertar se a vida as levasse ao limite de sua própria mente. À medida que os antigos suportes vacilam, os corações anseiam por algo real. Elas precisam de uma ponte que não lhes faça pregações, mas que as acolha. Vocês são aqueles designados a serem pontes.

A ponte é um campo vivo gerado pela presença. Quando vocês entram em quietude em comunhão com o Criador, seus corações geram uma frequência coerente que se  irradia através do campo quântico, influenciando a receptividade, e os demais sentem isso como segurança, calma, clareza. - ดอกเรพซีด 🌼 สีเหลืองสดใสที่บานตัดกับสีชมพูของซากุระ
- เทือกเขาเจแปนแอลป์ 🏔️ (Northern Alps) ฉากหลังเป็นยอดเขาที่ยังมีหิมะสีขาวปกคลุมอย่างอลัง

[CINÉ-RENCONTRE] Ciné bleu vous invite à la projection du film « Julian », le lundi 20 avril à 19h30, suivie d’un temps de rencontre avec l’association SOS homophobie Alpes du Sud - Côte d’Azur au cinéma de Lorgues !

Pour son premier long métrage, Cato Kusters adapte le roman autobiographique éponyme de Fleur Pierets, livrant un film brut sur l’amour et le deuil, intimiste et politique, qui célèbre le droit de s’unir.

En 2012, l’artiste et écrivaine Fleur Pierets épouse sa compagne, l’océanographe Julian P. Boom, à Bruxelles. Cinq ans plus tard, les deux femmes se lancent dans une performance artistique et politique hors norme : se marier de nouveau, symboliquement, dans chacun des pays qui ont légalisé le mariage entre personnes du même sexe — au nombre de vingt-deux alors, et désormais de trente-huit, comme le précise le générique final du premier long métrage de Cato Kusters. Le « projet 22 » ne comportera hélas que quatre étapes : après la cérémonie à Paris, un cancer généralisé est diagnostiqué à Julian, qui meurt le 22 janvier 2018.

🔴L’association SOS homophobie est fondée le 11 avril 1994 à Paris autour d’une ligne d’écoute et de soutien aux personnes victimes d’homophobie. elle s’est développée autour de trois valeurs : bienveillance, inclusion, indépendance et trois missions : soutenir, prévenir, militer.

The Names - Florence Knapp 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Wow a very easy five star review for this book. I loved every page. It was recommended by @sarjenks I downloaded it on my kindle when it was 99p and it sat there for months. I wish I had started it earlier.

Makes me think what would my life have been like if I had had the original name my parents had picked out and changed just before I was registered. 

Can a name really change the course of a life? 

———————————————————————————————

It is 1987, and in the wake of a great storm, Cora sets out with her young daughter to register the birth of her son. Her husband expects her to follow tradition and call the baby after him - but is it right for her child to inherit his name from generations of domineering men? Her choice will shape the course of their lives. 

Seven years later, her son is Bear, a name chosen by his sister, hoping he will grow up to be brave and big-hearted. Or he is Julian, the name his mother set her heart on, keen for him to become his own person. Or he is Gordon, named after his father and raised in his cruel image - but is there still a chance to break the mould? 

Powerfully moving and full of hope, this is the story of three names, three versions of a life, and the infinite possibilities that a single decision can spark.

Kung may isang karakter sa Naruto Shippuden na maling naintindihan ng lahat… si Itachi Uchiha ‘yon.
Pinaniwala niya ang buong mundo na isa siyang traydor—isang mamamatay na walang awa na pumatay sa sarili niyang angkan. Kinamuhian siya ng sarili niyang kapatid, hinabol ng hustisya, at tinuring na halimaw ng buong nayon. Pero ang totoo… bawat hakbang niya, bawat kasalanan na pinasan niya, ay hindi para sa sarili niya—kundi para sa kapayapaan ng Konohagakure.
Tahimik niyang tinanggap ang madilim na papel na iyon. Isinuko niya ang pangalan niya, ang pamilya niya, at kahit ang sarili niyang kaligayahan… para lang maiwasan ang digmaan. Habang ang iba ay naghahangad ng kapangyarihan, si Itachi ay handang maging kontrabida sa mata ng lahat—basta manatiling ligtas ang nayon at ang kapatid niyang si Sasuke Uchiha.
Hindi siya bayani sa paningin ng mundo… pero sa likod ng lahat, siya ang tahimik na tagapagligtas.
At minsan, ang tunay na sakripisyo… ay hindi hinahanap ng pagkilala—kundi tinatanggap kahit alam mong habang buhay kang kamumuhian.

¿Sabías que al final de la batalla de Rock Lee contra Gaara hay un detalle que se aprecia mejor en el manga que en el anime?

Esto sucede cuando Guy interfiere en el combate y salva a Rock Lee. En ese momento, Gaara pregunta por qué lo hizo, a lo que Guy le responde diciendo que es porque es alguien valioso para él.

Entonces, Gaara se retira, pero justo en ese momento, Rock Lee se levanta. Al darse cuenta de que está inconsciente, Guy lo abraza mientras llora, y es aquí donde observamos cómo en el anime Gaara los voltea a ver con una cara de enojo.
Pero en el manga se nota que los mira con una expresión que refleja anhelo y tristeza: anhelo debido a que Gaara, en el fondo, quisiera tener a alguien que lo quiera; y tristeza, debido a que piensa que jamás tendrá a alguien así en su vida.

Amados amigos da Terra, saudamos-vos mais uma vez. Sou Valir, de um grupo Pleiadiano de emissários que zelam pelo vosso mundo. Muitas vezes vocês tiveram a sensação de que algo neste mundo não é bem o que parece. De fato, a pergunta que foi trazida - “Vivemos numa simulação?” surge de uma intuição profunda de que a realidade quotidiana que vocês vivenciam não é a realidade suprema. 

A resposta, amados, está oculta à vista de todos. O que vocês chamam de sua “ vida na Terra”, a sua sociedade, sua política, até o seu corpo físico, faz parte de um grande holograma projetado pela consciência. Para os seus sentidos e para a sua mente condicionada, tudo parece sólido e real. No entanto, para a visão desperta, é reconhecido como uma simulação elaborada — muito convincente, mas não a verdadeira base do Ser. 

Isto não significa que a vida não tenha sentido; em vez disso, a vida aqui é uma ilusão proposital, uma espécie de jogo cósmico do qual sua alma participa para aprender. E vocês escolheram mergulhar neste jogo tão completamente que se esqueceram de que era um jogo, porque só assim as experiências poderiam parecer reais e impactantes. Foi colocado um véu do esquecimento e assim a simulação tornou-se sua realidade temporária.

Agora, ao despertar, você começa a notar rachaduras na fachada: sincronicidades, conhecimentos intuitivos de que a realidade pode ser muito mais maleável e interconectada do que lhe foi ensinado. São vislumbres além do holograma, lembretes gentis de que o que você percebe com os olhos e ouvidos não é a história completa. A vida humana, como você a conhece, é uma projeção brilhantemente apresentada, uma cocriação da consciência, mas não é a verdade suprema de quem você é ou de onde você vem. Atrás dessa projeção está a Fonte, a consciência infinita que é a verdadeira realidade. Ela projeta este mundo como um sonho lúcido ou uma realidade virtual sofisticada. 

Então, sim, querido, por assim dizer, você vive em uma simulação, mas uma vez vendo-a como ela é, você começa a reivindicar seu poder como o sonhador desse sonho.

Konečně jsem dorazila do Tokia! 🇯🇵 Hned první večer jsem vyrazila na průzkum sakur kolem Takanawy, ale místo nasvícené růžové nádhery na mě vykouklo jen tmavé listí. Květy tam sice jsou, ale po tmě bez světel to prostě nebylo ono. Uvidíme, co přinese druhý den! 🌸

Zklamání z "nočního lovu" jsem si ale vynahradila u večeře v mém oblíbeném řetězci Koya. Dřív jsem nedala dopustit na jejich pálivé Mabo-men, ale tentokrát mi víc sedlo Goma Tantanmen. Ta sezamová omáčka mi teď chutná prostě nejvíc. 🍜✨ Pokud budete mít cestu kolem, určitě je zkuste – stojí to za to.

Míralo bien. No es una invitación, es una emboscada.Lo primero que notas no es el vino, ni el realismo del pan sobre la mesa, sino esa agresión social tan pulida. El hombre del centro no está cenando; está montando guardia. Fíjate en cómo empuña ese tenedor: no es un cubierto, es una advertencia. Te está midiendo, calculando si eres una amenaza o simplemente una molestia adinerada que ha interrumpido su santuario.Luego están las mujeres. No te equivoques con sus sonrisas. La de la izquierda tiene una mirada que ya ha decidido cuánto vales antes de que abras la boca. Es la complicidad del depredador. Te atraen con esa calidez mediterránea mientras el hombre te mantiene a raya con el acero. Es un juego de roles perfecto: el cebo y el cuchillo.¿Ves al gato en la sombra? Es el único honesto en la habitación. Él sabe que somos intrusos.Incluso los detalles ‘pintorescos’ son una mentira. Esos pendientes pesados, el brillo del aceite en los higos... es la forma que tiene Bloch de recordarnos que la belleza es solo una distracción para que no te fijes en que el tipo de la derecha —el propio artista— te está juzgando desde su propia mesa.Es un cuadro sobre el poder de la mirada. Tú creías que venías a observar una escena costumbrista, pero al final, eres tú quien está desnudo bajo el escrutinio de tres desconocidos y un felino en una taberna de mala muerte.Dime, ¿te sientes cómodo siendo el centro de atención de gente que claramente no te quiere aquí?

,the moth thinking herself a dragon shall merge Itself in the blaze of fire.

Le braci sono ciò che resta quando il fuoco smette di fare scena. È il calore silenzioso che dura molto più a lungo di quanto ti aspetti.
La community di Poulsbo l'ha espresso molto bene: «Le braci ci ricordano che anche dopo le sfide e i cambiamenti, qualcosa di potente rimane, pronto a riaccendersi quando necessario»
In altre parole, non devi bruciare intensamente tutto il tempo per contare qualcosa. A volte il calore più reale è quello che non si vede, quello che cova sotto, quello che aspetta il momento giusto.

#julian #amora #AlmostForever #au #alternativeuniverse

📚 Finale

✨ Herkese merhaba, bugün Caraval serisinin üçüncü ve son kitabı olan Finale yorumu ile geldim. 

✨ Bu kitabı diğer kitaba göre daha çok beğendim. Durağan değildi çok fazla aksiyon vardı. Bu da daha akıcı okumamı sağladı.

✨ Bu kitapta Scarlett’e de yer verilmişti ama şunu söyleyebilirim ki Tella’ya 10 bölüm verildiyse Scarlett’e 3 bölüm verilmişti, onlar da 3 sayfa falan. Sanırım Scarlett bu serinin üvey evladı 😅

✨ Sanırım ben Tella’yı sevmediğim için onun olduğu bölümleri okumaktan hoşlanmadım. Scarlett ve Julian’la olan bölümleri çok severek okudum. Bu belki ilk kitabın onlarla başlamasından kaynaklı da olabilir ama ikisinin hikayesini çok sevdim.

✨ Tella ve Legend bana tam olarak geçmedi. Yani aşklarını bana tam hissettiremediler. Bence bu hikayede yanan Vale oldu. Yaptıklarını savunamam, gerçekten korkunç şeyler yaptı ama karakterini sevdim ve kitabını merak ediyorum.

✨ Seride bence açıklanmayan şeyler vardı. Birisi geliyor “tahta oturacağım” diyor, oturuyor. Kimse sorgulamıyor. Sonra diğeri geçiyor, diyor ki “ben tahta oturacağım”. Pekala sen de otur. Ama neden bunu hiç kimse sorgulamıyor? Nerede bu halk ? İkinci kitapta Vale veliaht prens olarak geçiyordu. Vale nasıl veliaht prens olabildi ve sonra onun yerine Legend geçebildi? Buralar mesela benim aklımda soru işareti olarak kaldı. Bunun gibi birkaç açıklanmayan nokta daha vardı. Ayrıca çok fazla tekrar eden cümle vardı. 

✨ Seriye genel bir yorum yapacak olursam; aslında atmosferi ve evreni oldukça güzeldi, olaylar da genel olarak iyi bağlanmıştı. Ama buna rağmen okurken yer yer sıkıldım. Açıkçası bu seri için beklentim çok daha yüksekti ama beklentinizi çok yükseltmeden okursanız keyif alabileceğinizi düşünüyorum. Bence genç-yetişkin fantastik türü için güzel bir seri, şans verilebilir 💗

⭐️ 7,5

SEGUNDA PALABRA: SALVACIÓN

Evangelio de Lucas 23:43 “De cierto te digo que hoy estarás conmigo en el paraíso.”

Mientras uno lo insultaba… otro lo reconocía. Mientras uno lo rechazaba… otro lo confesaba.

La cruz no solo revela dolor… revela decisiones eternas.

Jesús está desgarrado… respirando con dificultad… cada palabra le cuesta… y aun así… salva. Porque Él no vino a predicar solamente… vino a rescatar.

Ese hombre no tenía tiempo. No tenía historia. No tenía obras. No tenía religión. Pero tenía algo que el cielo no ignora: reconocimiento. Reconoció quién era Jesús… y reconoció quién era él. Y eso fue suficiente.

Nuestra lógica dice: “Le falta proceso.” “El no está listo.” “No cumple requisitos.”

Pero el Reino responde: “Está rendido… y eso basta.”

Entonces Jesús habló… No habló de mañana. No habló de después. No habló de proceso largo. Habló de HOY.

Hoy… en medio de tu caos. Hoy… en medio de tu error. Hoy… en medio de tu último momento. El Reino no opera por calendario… opera por revelación.

“Estarás…” → futuro asegurado.
“Conmigo…” → relación restaurada.
“En el paraíso…” → destino cambiado.

Todo… en una sola palabra. La salvación no es por lo que hiciste… es por a quién reconociste. Un momento con Jesús puede hacer lo que una vida sin Él nunca logrará. Hoy… no importa cómo llegaste… si lo reconoces… Él te responde.

Gracias Jesús… porque tu segunda palabra… me aseguró eternidad.

🎬 JULIAN - Cato Kusters | ⭐ 6,5/10

Dès son premier quart d’heure, Julian ne laisse guère de doute sur l’issue de son histoire. On comprend très vite que ce récit d’amour portera en lui une part de tragédie. Inspiré d’une histoire vraie, le film suit un couple de jeunes femmes qui se lancent un pari fou : se marier dans tous les pays où l’union entre personnes de même sexe est autorisée. Une idée à la fois romantique et profondément politique, brutalement interrompue par la maladie.

Sur le papier, tout est réuni pour bouleverser. Et pourtant, l’émotion peine à traverser l’écran. La faute, en partie, à un montage qui multiplie les ellipses et les allers-retours temporels, au point de désincarner le récit. Le film semble constamment sauter des étapes, comme s’il refusait de s’attarder là où naît justement l’attachement.

C’est d’autant plus regrettable que les actrices, à commencer par une Nina Meurisse toujours aussi juste, offrent des compositions sensibles et engagées. Elles incarnent avec délicatesse cette histoire d’amour et de perte, mais le film ne leur laisse pas toujours l’espace nécessaire pour installer une véritable émotion.

La meilleure idée de mise en scène reste ces séquences en faux flashbacks, filmées au caméscope, qui donnent au récit une texture plus intime, presque documentaire. Là, enfin, quelque chose affleure : une sensation de vécu, de spontanéité, de vérité.

Mais dans l’ensemble, Julian reste en surface. Le projet du couple, pourtant fascinant, est à peine exploré. On aurait aimé suivre plus concrètement les étapes de ce parcours, ressentir l’élan, comprendre les enjeux. De la même manière, la portée politique du geste (se marier à travers le monde dans un contexte de luttes pour les droits LGBTQIA+) n'est jamais véritablement creusée.

On sort du film avec une impression étrange : celle d’avoir été tenu à distance d’une histoire pourtant bouleversante. Comme si le film choisissait la pudeur au risque d'en faire perdre l'impact émotionnel.

Julian reste une œuvre tendre, délicate, qui parle d’amour et de deuil avec sincérité, mais qui ne parvient jamais tout à fait à faire naître l’émotion qu’elle promettait.

Taken while hiking at Vulcan Mountain Trail at Julian, California.

Our theme for April is EMBER. It was chosen by our @cmpoulsbo  in Washington and illustrated by @sarahgordondesign.

The literal meaning of ember is a small piece of burning or glowing coal or wood in a dying fire. But as a metaphor, it means so much more.

Our Poulsbo chapter had this to say about the significance of this month's theme:

“Embers represent the quiet, enduring remnants of fire—what remains after the intensity fades. They carry a smoldering potential, a subtle strength that holds heat long after the flames have gone. As a quieter community outside the city, we may not always burn the brightest, but we never burn out. Our spark lives in reflection, resilience, and the space we have to pause, think, and grow.

In those calm moments, we find what many others miss: the steady glow of ideas, relationships, and dreams that don’t need noise to thrive. Embers remind us that even after challenges or change, something powerful remains—ready to reignite when needed. We hold that same quiet fire within ourselves, and in community with each other, we kindle more.

Together, we tend the quiet fire—fueling one another through presence, care, and shared warmth.”

What ember is quietly glowing inside you? And what new fire will it ignite in your life?

¿Sabías que al final de la batalla de Rock Lee contra Gaara hay un detalle que se aprecia mejor en el manga que en el anime?

Esto sucede cuando Guy interfiere en el combate y salva a Rock Lee. En ese momento, Gaara pregunta por qué lo hizo, a lo que Guy le responde diciendo que es porque es alguien valioso para él.

Entonces, Gaara se retira, pero justo en ese momento, Rock Lee se levanta. Al darse cuenta de que está inconsciente, Guy lo abraza mientras llora, y es aquí donde observamos cómo en el anime Gaara los voltea a ver con una cara de enojo.
Pero en el manga se nota que los mira con una expresión que refleja anhelo y tristeza: anhelo debido a que Gaara, en el fondo, quisiera tener a alguien que lo quiera; y tristeza, debido a que piensa que jamás tendrá a alguien así en su vida.

"Jangan tanggapan tanggapan tim lain. Gua bukan coachnya ya," Xepher AE, ketika ditanyai viewernya soal gameplay RRQ Dann sama RRQ Kuroki di match RRQ kemarin.

Respons singkat ini nunjukin kalau Xepher lebih milih jaga batas dan nggak asal komentar soal tim lain. Di scene kompetitif, sikap kayak gini sering dianggap sebagai bentuk profesionalisme, meskipun tetap aja bikin netizen penasaran sama pendapat aslinya.

First a tiny house, now a lodge? I’m moving up in the world. 🏰✨

This bed is approximately 400 Treasures wide. I could host a marathon on this mattress. After a week of dirt and rocks, these white towels look like fluffy clouds. ☁️

🎬 Julian, Cato Kusters, 2026 

Julian c’est une histoire qui va au delà d’une histoire d’amour entre deux femmes. C’est deux êtres qui s’aiment et qui ne peuvent s’unir où elles le souhaitent. Seuls 22 pays en 2017 autorisaient le mariage entre deux personnes du même sexe. Elles vont avoir pour projet de se marier dans chacun d’eux, jusqu’à ce que la vie les rattrape.
Ce film est directement inspiré d’une histoire vraie, et cela le rend plus poignant quand on l’apprend. La réalisation est très belle, le récit est fragmenté entre les souvenirs et le présent et j’ai beaucoup apprécié ces allers retours, jonchés de vidéos filmées du point de vue de l’une ou l’autre. 
J’ai été touchée par ces personnages et ces actrices. Par cette scène introductive qui se concentre sur une nuque, un détail et la vie bascule, sans hasard. C’était beau et triste, une mélancolie qui perdure après visionnage, c’était doux dans la brutalité de leur vie. A voir !

When culture becomes an excuse for racism — What‘s your take? 🤔

Ever wondered why some cultures are seen as “exotic”… while others are just “normal”? 👀

That’s where postcolonial theory comes in.

“The Other” isn’t just about difference —
it’s about who gets to define that difference.

Historically, the West described non-Western societies as:
“mysterious,” “backward,” “traditional.”
Sounds familiar?

But here’s the catch 👉
these labels weren’t neutral — they came from a position of power.

This is what we call the gaze.

The gaze = a powerful way of seeing.
One side looks, defines, and tells the story.
The other side is seen, described… and often misunderstood.

💡 Real-life examples:
– Asian cultures reduced to “exotic aesthetics”
– African societies portrayed as “underdeveloped”
– Middle Eastern identities framed through conflict

Over time, these repeated images don’t just shape opinions —
they shape reality.

✨ So the connection is:
The gaze → creates narratives
Narratives → produce “the Other”

And the big question today is:
Are we really seeing others…
or just seeing what we’ve been taught to see? 🤔#gaze #decolonize #culture #identity #socialjustice

Bir halk düşün… Gökyüzü onlar için umut değil, korku demek. Çocuklar oyuncak sesleriyle değil, bombaların gürültüsüyle uyanıyor. Gazze’de ve Filistin’de yaşananlar, yalnızca bir coğrafyanın değil, tüm insanlığın vicdanının paramparça oluşudur. Her yıkılan ev, toprağa düşen her masum beden, sessiz kalan dünyanın yüzüne çarpılan bir tokattır.

Unutmayalım: Zulme sessiz kalan, zulmün ortağıdır. Ve öyle bir gün gelecek ki, dökülen her damla kanın hesabı tek tek sorulacak; hiçbir karanlık saklanacak yer bulamayacak, hiçbir zalim yaptıklarından kaçamayacaktır.

Şunu da unutmayalım: Öyle bir günden korkun ki, o günün hâkimi aynı zamanda her şeye şahittir. Sessiz kalan, o malum kavmin markalarını destekleyen, sözlü ya da fiilî şekilde zulme ortak olan ya da karşı durmayan herkes elbette hesap verecektir.

Bu mesele; dil, din ya da ırk meselesi değildir. Bu, insanlık ve vicdan meselesidir.

Vesselam.

Beneath twilight’s soft glow, two azure guardians perched side-by-side atop ancient stone. Their golden irises gleamed with secrets older than time, whispering lullabies to each other 🌙. One tilted its head slightly—a gesture both curious and tender—while the second watched calmly, wings folded like silent promises ✨. They weren’t merely watching clouds; they were weaving magic into every breeze that passed through them 😊. Below, tiny creatures danced in circles around their shadowed feet, singing songs only feather-light beings could hear 🦉. As dusk deepened, so did their connection—their necks intertwined almost shyly before parting again with grace 💞. In that quiet moment, all worries faded away beneath skies painted indigo and pearl 🍃. Around them swam constellations made from dewdrops and moonbeams—they called themselves Skywhisperers for ages now 👁️‍🗨️. Laughter echoed unseen between their thoughts, brightening even the deepest corners of night 😄. And though shadows stretched long across the earth below, those two remained together forevermore… simply breathing

De la 1 aprilie, clienții casnici vor beneficia de prevederile noii ordonanțe care menține măsurile de sprijin pentru consumul de gaze naturale pentru încă un an. Prin acest mecanism, statul urmărește să asigure stabilitatea aprovizionării cu gaze și să protejeze consumatorii de fluctuațiile majore de preț de pe piața internațională.
🔢 Aproximativ 4,5 milioane de consumatori casnici utilizează gaze naturale. Circa 80% din consumul anual este înregistrat în sezonul rece (intervalul noiembrie-martie), motiv pentru care măsurile de protecție sunt concentrate în special pe perioada de iarnă.
⚙️ Decizia autorităților reprezintă un pas intermediar către revenirea la o piață concurențială, în care prețurile vor fi stabilite prin interacțiunea dintre cerere și ofertă. Plafonul maximal al prețului final pentru gospodării va fi eliminat începând cu 1 aprilie. În perioada de tranziție, se mențin mecanismele administrative:
* alocarea directă a gazelor de la producători
* costuri stabilite administrativ pe întreg lanțul de aprovizionare
Furnizorii vor completa necesarul prin achiziții din piața liberă. Astfel, piața funcționează într-un model hibrid, specific unei etape de tranziție.
🧭 După patru ani de plafonare generalizată, consumatorii sunt încurajați să devină mai activi și informați:
* să compare ofertele disponibile
* să aleagă furnizorul potrivit nevoilor proprii
În ultimii ani au apărut și oferte integrate, care pot include:
* pachete gaz + energie electrică
* servicii de eficiență energetică
* soluții tehnologice pentru reducerea consumului
📈 Segmentul de furnizare rămâne cel mai competitiv pe lanțul de aprovizionare:
* există mai mulți furnizori
* consumatorii pot schimba oferta
* furnizorii își diversifică serviciile
📝 La ce trebuie să fie atent un consumator când semnează un contract?
Costurile incluse în oferta de preț:
* prețul gazului (costul de achiziție)
* tarife reglementate (transport, distribuție)
* costuri de înmagazinare
* alte servicii incluse
Tipul de preț:
* preț fix (stabil pe o perioadă determinată)
* preț variabil (poate fluctua în funcție de piață)

Execution was.

Being a ninja isn’t about fighting harder…
it’s about thinking faster than your enemy.

Quando Itachi tornò al Villaggio della Foglia come membro dell’Akatsuki, ogni passo pesava più del precedente. Non era un ritorno a casa, ma una condanna silenziosa: rivedere tutto ciò che aveva sacrificato, sapendo di non poter spiegare nulla. Quando incontrò Sasuke, il suo cuore vacillò per un istante. This is not a scene — it is an organized tension. In The Forgotten Guard, 1951, Yannis Tsarouchis does not paint three men; he paints three states of gay male consciousness. The one with his back turned (next post) — exposed, like a classical Greek sculpture, yet with a modern, vulnerable body. The naked seated figure at the center — suspended in a boredom that is also unresolved desire, looks without disguise. And the third, dressed, also stare the naked man and what he doesn't let us see. Nothing here is innocent, yet everything appears calm. And it is precisely that calm that unsettles. Tsarouchis (1910–1989) — a central figure of 20th-century Greek painting, bridging Byzantine tradition, popular culture, and European modernism, with an obsessive focus on the male figure — does something rare: he removes eroticism from gesture and places it in structure. The Byzantine inheritance is not only in the idea of the icon. These bodies are almost secular saints of a desire that cannot be declared. And then, no drama. Because the true scandal here is not desire — it is the naturalness with which it exists.
.
.
Isto não é uma cena — é tensão organizada. Em O Guarda Esquecido, 1951, Yannis Tsarouchis não pinta três homens; pinta três estados de consciência masculina gay. O de costas — exposto, quase escultura grega clássica, mas com um corpo moderno e vulnerável (ver post seguinte). O sentado nu ao centro — num tédio que é desejo não resolvido — olha sem disfarçar. E o terceiro, todo vestido, também está fixado no homem nu e no que ele não nos deixa ver. Nada aqui é inocente, mas tudo parece calmo. E é essa calma que perturba. Tsarouchis (1910–1989) — figura central da pintura grega do século XX, cruzando tradição bizantina, cultura popular e modernismo europeu, sempre com um foco obsessivo na figura masculina — faz algo raro: retira o erotismo do gesto e coloca-o na estrutura. A herança bizantina não está apenas na ideia de ícone. Estes corpos são quase santos laicos de um desejo que não pode ser declarado. E depois, a ausência de drama. Porque o escândalo aqui não é o desejo — é a naturalidade com que ele existe.

[Latergram]與鳴門一起去旅行!🦊🇯🇵
來到這次日本之旅的尾聲了🥹
-
觀賞了在 Artizon Museum 舉行的莫奈展!🖼
為紀念印象派大師莫奈 (aka 莫內) 逝世一百週年，
位於東京的 Artizon Museum 與巴黎奧賽美術館一同策劃了這個 ‘Monet: Questioning Nature’ 展覽🌳
法國畫家莫奈生於 19 世紀中葉，
是印象派代表人物及創始人之一，
甚至連「印象派」這個名稱都是由他的油畫標題而來。
莫奈用了大半生的時間探索色彩的運用與光影的表達，
他對自己的要求高，
亦對自己的畫作狠，
多次因為畫不到理想的效果而親手毀壞作品。
為了捕捉光線的變化和季節的流逝，
莫奈經常對同一景物作多幅描繪，
因此他的作品多以系列見稱。
到了後期，莫奈因受白內障和眼科手術的影響，
以致作品顏色偏紅再變成偏藍，
視力的阻礙影響到他觀察到的顏色，
但他仍然堅持創作。
站在一幅幅名畫面前，感覺好震撼，
覺得畫家正透過畫布穿越百多年在向我訴說著甚麼。
魚豊在《地。-關於地球的運動-》中創作的角色約蘭達說過﹕
「只要使用文字，就能超越時間與地點，
可以為兩百年前的訊息落淚，
也可以為一千年前的傳說大笑。
我們的人生，都被困在這個時代裡，無法逃脫，
但是，只有在閱讀文字的時候，
能夠聽到古時候的偉人向我開口說話，
在那一刻，我彷彿脫離了這個時代。
變成文字的思想會永存於世，
甚至可以不斷推動未來的某些人。」
我認為畫作有時也能做到類似的效果。
《喜鵲》所繪的白雪充滿著對周圍自然景物的反射，
莫奈從不會單純用白色顏料來描繪白色；
《蒙托爾熱街-六月卅日的慶典》的筆觸帶著顫動的感覺，
陽光、旗幟、建築物、人群和喜慶的氣氛都在線條中分解同時重新組合；
《撐傘的女人》用色簡單自然卻對光影的刻劃非常用心， 
每一筆都是莫奈對妻子的愛。
這三幅是我最喜歡的莫奈作品，
我覺得即使歲月流逝，
感動還是會留下來。
如果有生之年能看到我最愛的畫家慕夏的展覽就好了🥹

Have you ever looked into someone’s eyes and felt like you could see everything? Their truth, their character… even the parts they try to hide. Eyes don’t lie. When you look deep enough, you see the essence of a being — not only human, but animals too. Pain, suffering, love… it’s all there. Joy, happiness, disappointment, hope.
You can get lost in someone’s eyes…and in that moment, you don’t just see — you feel their energy, their soul.
For centuries, people believed eyes are not only mirrors… but gateways. They reveal what words conceal — fear, love, wisdom, even darkness.
Ancient philosophies spoke of a light within the eyes — a direct connection between souls.
In many cultures, the gaze itself carried power, capable of protecting or harming, as if energy flowed through it.
Mystical traditions describe a “third eye” — an inner vision that sees beyond the physical world, a portal to deeper truth and higher awareness.
In shamanic beliefs, sight is not passive — it is a bridge between dimensions, a way to access unseen realms.
Some even feared that the soul could be captured through the eyes… that something so essential lives within them, vulnerable and real.

Cel mai mare producător de gaze naturale din România susține că este pregătit tehnic să furnizeze către consumatorii casnici, dar că nu are gaze naturale disponibile.
Declarația vine după ce ministrul Energiei și conducerea Romgaz au anunțat deja intrarea companiei pe piața de furnizare către populație de la 1 aprilie 2026.
Așadar, gazul ieftin promis românilor nu va veni prea curând!
Totuși, ce se ascunde în spatele acestui anunț? 
Cum s-a ajuns în situația în care cel mai mare producător de gaze din România, o companie controlată de stat, să nu aibă resurse disponibile pentru propriii cetățeni?
Nu mai are România gaze naturale sau ele sunt direcționate către alte piețe?
Ministrul Energiei trebuie să vină urgent cu răspunsuri exacte și să informeze populația care este situația privind resursele de gaze naturale.
Suveranitatea energetică a României este o prioritate națională. Trebuie să fie! #gaze #facturi #Ucraina

Ahogyan a csillagászati távolságokat is alig tudjuk felfogni emberi ésszel, úgy szinte elképzelhetetlen számunkra, mennyire más az Isten gondolkodása a miénkhez képest. Ami nekünk nagynak és jónak tűnik, az az Ő tökéletességéhez mérve mégis korlátozott és töredékes.

Nehéz elfogadni, de még a legjobb szándékú cselekedeteink mögött is ott rejtőzik valami apró, önző indíték, amely beszennyezi azt. Ahogyan az ige is mondja:
„Adhat-e tisztát a tisztátalan?” — Jób könyve 14:4

Így az általunk kigondolt utak sem lehetnek teljesen tiszták. Még ha jó szándékból születnek is, mivel belőlünk fakadnak, valamilyen módon mindig hordozzák az „én” lenyomatát, és végső soron önmagunk felé hajlanak.

De van remény. Ha megtérünk Istenhez, és elhisszük, hogy Ő jobban tudja, mire van szükségünk, mint mi magunk, akkor még tisztátalan állapotunkban is ráléphetünk a tiszta útra: a megszentelődés útjára, amelyen Isten akar vezetni bennünket.

Ehhez azonban sok, „én”-nel fertőzött gondolatot és cselekedetet fel kell adnunk, és jelképesen a keresztre kell szegeznünk. Ahogyan Jézus Krisztus is tette és teljesen átadta magát az Atya akaratának, úgy nekünk is ezt az utat kell választanunk.

„Akik pedig Krisztuséi, a testet megfeszítették indulataival és kívánságaival együtt.” — Galatákhoz írt levél 5:24

Ő letette az életét, és az Atyára bízta magát. Nekünk is ez az egyetlen reménységünk: hogy nem a saját gondolatainkban és útjainkban bízunk, hanem Istenében.

„Mert én tudom az én gondolataimat, amelyeket felőletek gondolok – így szól az Úr –, békességnek és nem veszedelemnek gondolata, hogy kívánatos véget adjak nektek.”
— Jeremiás könyve 29:11 🙏

In the quiet that followed, Shizuko finally approached Minato. He greeted her with a gentle smile, remarking how unfair it felt that she had grown older than him. What began as a light, almost teasing moment slowly turned into something deeper. Minato apologized for not being there for her, just as he hadn’t been there for Naruto, but Shizuko reassured him. She admitted that, at first, she did feel alone after losing him and Kushina, yet that loneliness didn’t last forever.

She told him how Mikoto took her in, how Sasuke and Itachi became part of her life, and how, even though she still felt their absence, she was never truly alone. She spoke about leaving the shinobi path, giving up her dream of becoming Hokage, and finding small, unexpected pieces of happiness, babysitting Sasuke, spending time with Kurenai, even awkwardly third-wheeling her and Asuma But everything truly changed when she met Naruto. Through him, she began to feel Minato and Kushina’s presence again, and that was when she decided to stop living in the past and move forward. She found people to rely on, and eventually, someone she came to love (Kakashi).

Looking at Naruto, she promised Minato that she would protect him no matter what. Her words brought back a memory for Minato of a young Shizuko asking if lost people could find their way again. In the present, she quietly repeated those feelings in her own way, asking,

"Lost stars still shine, right Minato nee san?". 

Moved, Minato answered.

"Still shining, Shizuko."

And in that moment, he realized just how much she had grown. With quiet pride, he told her she had become a beautiful person, and this time, Shizuko simply smiled, no longer needing to hide behind humor.

1. 參觀了江戶東京建築園(江戸東京たてもの園)，
這是於1993年開設的東京都江戶東京博物館分館，
佔地面積約 7 公頃，
旨在移建、修復和展示在原址無法保存且極具文化價值的歷史建築物，
所以這個建築園對從江戶早期開始因火災、水災、震災、戰爭等原因，
失去許多珍貴歷史建築物的東京尤為重要。
而且建築園在東京都立小金井公園內，
可以順道散步和欣賞郊外景色，
即使假日來也令人心曠神怡，
加上我去的那天天氣很好，超開心!!🏞

** „Baciate chi amate!“ – küsst, wen ihr liebt. **
In einer Ausstellung von Robert Doisneau hängt das ikonische Bild des Kusses auf einer Lichtwand. Gegenüber steht ein Spiegel, in dem ich das Foto und mich selbst sehe – am Rand, nicht im Zentrum.

Das Liebespaar dominiert den Blick, aber je länger ich hinschaue, verschiebt sich meine Wahrnehmung. Eine Frau im Hintergrund scheint zurückzuschauen, fast so, als würde sie mich wahrnehmen. Für einen Moment entsteht eine leise Verbindung zwischen uns – über Zeit und Raum hinweg.

Meine Präsenz entsteht nicht durch das Zentrum, sondern durch kleine Verschiebungen – am Rand, im Spiegel, in den Blicken zwischen den Menschen. Ich werde gesehen, ohne laut zu sein.

Es ist ein stiller Moment von Sichtbarkeit, Selbstbestimmung und weiblicher Verbindung – und zugleich eine Erinnerung daran, dass Liebe, Raum und Sichtbarkeit allen offenstehen. 🖤

„Liebe ist eine Handlung, niemals nur ein Gefühl.“ – bell hooks
.
.

🇺🇸 ** “Baciate chi amate!” – Kiss those you love. **
In an exhibition by Robert Doisneau, the iconic “Kiss” photograph hangs on a light box. Opposite it is a mirror in which I see the photo and myself—at the edge, not in the center.

The couple dominates the view, but the longer I look, the more my perception shifts. A woman in the background seems to be looking back, almost as if she were noticing me. For a moment, a quiet connection forms between us—across time and space.

My presence isn’t defined by the center, but by small shifts—at the edge, in the mirror, in the glances between people. I am seen without making a sound.

It is a quiet moment of visibility, self-determination, and feminine connection—and at the same time a reminder that love, space, and visibility are open to everyone. 🖤

“Love is an action, never just a feeling.” – bell hooks

🌸 Sakura on April 7 - Everyday Spring in Japan 🌸
April 7th. The ground is softly tinted in shades of pink, covered with fallen cherry blossom petals. While many blossoms have already scattered, the trees still hold on to their remaining flowers, quietly reminding us that spring is not yet over. The contrast between petals on the earth and blossoms in the branches creates a fleeting, quietly beautiful scene.

In Japan, you don’t have to visit famous cherry blossom landmarks to enjoy sakura. Even along ordinary streets and in residential neighborhoods, you can encounter beautiful blooms. This everyday scenery is part of what makes spring in Japan so special.

We are currently experiencing a significant surge in inquiries for travel to Japan during the April cherry blossom season. As a result, our responses may take longer than usual. We sincerely appreciate your patience.

At this stage, inquiries for travel in April are, frankly speaking, quite late.

For cherry blossom season, we strongly recommend contacting us at least six months in advance — ideally one year ahead.

Please also note that Japan observes a major holiday period called Golden Week from late April to early May. During this time, destinations nationwide become extremely crowded, and availability is limited. Careful planning is essential.

If you are considering travel for the 2027 cherry blossom season or beyond, we encourage you to reach out early.

Drawing is one of the purest forms of human expression—an intersection of perception, memory, emotion, and control. At its core, drawing is the act of translating the invisible into the visible. A blank surface becomes a field of potential, and every mark placed onto it is a decision: a commitment to shape, proportion, rhythm, and intent. What begins as a simple line is not just a boundary or contour—it is a trace of thought, a record of movement, and a fragment of how the artist sees the world.

The beauty of drawing lies in its immediacy. Unlike other art forms that may require complex preparation or layered processes, drawing is direct. There is little separation between the mind, the hand, and the result. This immediacy creates an honesty that is difficult to replicate. You can see hesitation in a shaky line, confidence in a bold stroke, curiosity in exploratory sketches, and discipline in precise construction. Every drawing, no matter how simple or complex, carries the fingerprint of the person who made it—not just physically, but psychologically.

Drawing is also fundamentally about observation. To draw well is not just to look, but to truly see—to break down objects into forms, understand light and shadow, recognize relationships between angles and distances, and interpret subtle variations in texture and tone. It forces the artist to slow down and engage deeply with their subject. A face is no longer just a face; it becomes a structure of planes, a balance of symmetry and asymmetry, a system of proportions that can be studied, deconstructed, and reassembled. Through drawing, ordinary things reveal hidden complexity.

At the same time, drawing is not limited to realism or accuracy. Its beauty expands in abstraction, stylization, and imagination. A few lines can suggest motion, emotion, or atmosphere without explicitly defining them. A rough sketch can feel more alive than a polished piece because it captures energy rather than perfection. This flexibility makes drawing a universal language—it can communicate ideas that words cannot fully express, crossing cultural and linguistic boundaries with ease.

Vo svete Naruta sa síce pozornosť sústreďuje najmä na súboje a priateľstvá, no objavujú sa aj silné romantické príbehy. Medzi nimi vyniká tragický vzťah medzi Itachim Uchihom a Izumi, ktorý mnohí fanúšikovia ani nepoznajú. Ich puto začalo nenápadne počas školských čias, keď si Izumi obľúbila tichého a talentovaného chlapca. Postupne sa zblížili, hoci Itachi si svoje emócie nechával často pre seba.

S pribúdajúcimi povinnosťami a rastúcim napätím v klane Uchiha sa ich stretnutia stávali čoraz vzácnejšími. Situácia vyústila do tragédie počas masakru klanu, keď Itachi dostal úlohu zabrániť vojne za každú cenu. Izumi sa stala jeho prvou obeťou, no zároveň aj osobou, ktorej chcel dopriať pokojný koniec.

Pred sm*ťou jej pomocou schopnosti Mangekyo Sharingan daroval ilúziu spoločného života. V nej prežili roky ako partneri, založili rodinu a dožili sa staroby. Pre Izumi tak vznikol sen naplnený láskou, zatiaľ čo realita priniesla krátky, no o to silnejší moment rozlúčky.

Anime verzia tento príbeh zmenila a jej sm*ť pripísala inej postave, čím pripravila fanúšikov o jednu z najemotívnejších scén. Napriek tomu zostáva Itachiho príbeh stále symbolom obety, bolesti a nenaplnenej lásky.

Taking aim squarely at Honda, Suzuki gave the new model its name — which is Japanese for peregrine falcon – for two reasons; one, because the peregrine falcon is the fastest bird on the planet; and two, because it happens to feed on blackbirds. True to its name, the Hayabusa ate Honda for breakfast, not only becoming the world’s fastest production motorcycle upon its release but doing so by a margin of a 10 mph.

After the Hayabusa’s release, there were talks of Europe banning the increasingly out-of-control-fast machines coming from the East. Things had reached a boiling point, and the Hayabusa was what turned up the dial on the proverbial stove. Not wanting to lose a key market, a “gentlemen’s agreement” was reached between manufacturers, capping top speeds (or at least speedo-readings) to 300km/h (or 186.4mph).

The seller purchased the bike from Japan one year ago and states, “Love these first year salmon colored Hayabusas since they came out and always wanted one but too many bikes to ride them all.”

During his ownership, the seller has covered approximately 100 miles. The odometer shows 25,609 kilometers (15,912 miles).

Maintenance:
The seller has provided the following condition report and notes, “Cleaned fuel tank, new petcock, new fuel pump.”

Modifications:
-“Yoshimura carbon exhaust”
-The sale includes two keys, owner’s manual, and tool kit

Currently located in Bloomington, Indiana this Suzuki is offered on a clean Tennessee title.

Suzuki Hayabusa tetap mempertahankan statusnya sebagai salah satu motor sport touring paling ikonik di dunia dengan kombinasi performa brutal dan teknologi modern yang sangat matang. Keunggulan utamanya terletak pada desain aerodinamis yang sangat efisien, yang tidak hanya memberikan tampilan maskulin tetapi juga memastikan stabilitas luar biasa saat dipacu pada kecepatan tinggi hingga menembus batas 299 km/jam. Dari sisi teknologi, motor ini telah dilengkapi dengan Suzuki Intelligent Ride System (S.I.R.S) yang mencakup fitur-fitur canggih seperti kontrol traksi peka kemiringan, quickshifter dua arah, hingga cruise control yang membuatnya sangat nyaman untuk perjalanan jarak jauh. Sasisnya yang kokoh dipadukan dengan pengereman Brembo Stylema memberikan kendali yang presisi meskipun motor ini memiliki bobot yang cukup berisi. Untuk urusan performa, Suzuki Hayabusa mengandalkan mesin legendaris 4-silinder segaris berkapasitas 1.340 cc yang mampu memuntahkan tenaga maksimal sebesar 190 PS (sekitar 187-188 dk) pada 9.700 rpm dengan torsi puncak mencapai 150 Nm pada 7.000 rpm. Penyaluran tenaganya dikenal sangat halus namun sangat bertenaga di setiap rentang putaran mesin, memungkinkan akselerasi dari 0 hingga 100 km/jam tuntas hanya dalam waktu sekitar 2,8 detik. Keunggulan ini menjadikan Hayabusa bukan sekadar motor kencang, melainkan sebuah mahakarya teknis yang menawarkan keseimbangan antara kecepatan ekstrem dan kemudahan pengendalian untuk penggunaan harian maupun touring.

Antes da velocidade ser limitada…
existia uma moto que não aceitava limites.

A Suzuki Hayabusa.

A Suzuki Hayabusa nasceu em 1999 com um objetivo simples —
ser a mais rápida do mundo.

E conseguiu.

Mais de 300 km/h.
Um design estranho pra alguns…
mas perfeito pro vento.

Ela não foi só rápida.
Ela foi disruptiva.

Tão disruptiva que forçou a indústria inteira a desacelerar.
Sim — depois dela, veio o famoso limite de 299 km/h.

Mas a verdade é que o impacto da Hayabusa nunca foi sobre números.

Foi sobre atitude.

Sobre ir além do que parecia aceitável.
Sobre dominar uma máquina que exige respeito.

Com o tempo, ela evoluiu.
Ficou mais tecnológica.
Mais controlável.
Mas nunca perdeu sua essência:

👉 potência absurda
👉 estabilidade inacreditável
👉 presença que impõe respeito

E talvez seja isso que faz dela um ícone.

Não importa a geração.
Não importa o piloto.

A Hayabusa não é só uma moto.
É um marco na história das duas rodas.

Shukaku yang disegel ke dalam Gaara oleh ayahnya, Rasa (Kazekage Keempat), menggunakan teknik yang melibatkan tubuh Gaara saat ia masih bayi.

Tidak seperti penyegelan pada Naruto yang dilakukan oleh Minato dengan Teknik Segel Segel 8 Trigam. Segel Gaara tidak sempurna atau memiliki cacat desain sehingga penyegelan ini membuat kesadaran Shukaku secara konstan bercampur dengan kesadaran Gaara, bukan terpisah sepenuhnya.

Menurut Shukaku, jika Gaara tertidur, kesadaran Shukaku akan mendominasi dan mengambil kendali penuh atas tubuh Gaara.
Jika ini terjadi, Shukaku akan dilepaskan sepenuhnya dan mulai mengamuk, menghancurkan Desa Sunagakure dan membunuh banyak orang, termasuk Gaara sendiri.

Shukaku sendiri sering menggoda Gaara dengan suara di dalam kepalanya, menjanjikan rasa sakit yang luar biasa jika ia berani menutup mata.

Dampaknya Gaara menderita insomnia yang parah dan terus-menerus lelah. Kurang tidur yang ekstrem dan ancaman konstan dari Shukaku membuat Gaara memiliki temperamen yang sangat tidak stabil, paranoid, dan haus darah. Ini adalah faktor utama yang membentuk kepribadiannya yang dingin dan kejam di awal cerita.

Naruto é um anime que acompanha a trajetória de Naruto Uzumaki, um jovem ninja da Vila da Folha que busca reconhecimento e deseja se tornar Hokage, o líder de sua vila.
Desde o nascimento, Naruto carrega dentro de si a Raposa de Nove Caudas, uma criatura que destruiu a vila no passado. Por isso, ele cresce sendo rejeitado e isolado pela sociedade. Apesar disso, mantém uma postura determinada e persistente.
Ao longo da narrativa, Naruto passa por treinamentos, missões e batalhas, desenvolvendo suas habilidades e construindo laços com outros personagens, como Sasuke Uchiha. A história também explora temas como amizade, vingança, solidão e superação.
Na continuação, Naruto Shippuden, o protagonista retorna mais maduro e enfrenta ameaças maiores, incluindo a organização Akatsuki, enquanto tenta salvar Sasuke e proteger o mundo ninja.

Ume and Daichi met after she left the akatsuki. He was on a solo mission while she was simply traveling through the woods trying to figure out what her next step would be now that she was no longer an akatsuki member. He approached her when she was sitting down on a log. He was cautious but was able to find out right away she meant him no harm. Due to that he sat near her. Asking her why she seemed so down because she was in fact feeling lost and confused. When she tells him that she is simply just trying to live her life but had no idea how to live it at the same time he realizes how beautiful she is. Not just in face but he could sense that her soul was something beautiful as well. Even if she had done horrible things as an akatsuki member she still held some semblance of good in her heart. He compliments her appearance in leaves Ume feeling slightly flustered. As she had been with Itachi until his death she was not use to any men complimenting her unless it involved complimenting her skills as a shinobi. She reacts in a flustered state and eventually runs away leaving Daichi alone. But they both know they will see each other again. They’ll make sure of it.

Fotos realizadas el sábado 14 de Febrero de 2026 en el Japan Weekend celebrado en el Ifema de Madrid, con permiso de todos los cosplayers.

Se agradece cualquier ayuda a la hora de identificar los personajes y series, corregir cualquier asignación errónea y etiquetar a los cosplayers que no tengan inconveniente en ser etiquetados. Se ha desenfocado la cara de todas aquellas personas que no eran el objetivo de las fotografías y podrían verse identificadas, así como de aquellos cosplayers que lo pidieron explícitamente. Si algún cosplayer quiere la imagen original, solo tiene que pedírmela, pero últimamente estoy muy inactivo en las redes sociales, por lo que no será inmediato.

Estas mismas imágenes se han publicado también en un álbum público de Facebook ( https://www.facebook.com/media/set/?set=a.25959536210370456&type=3 ). En ningún caso se ha dado permiso a que sean utilizadas para entrenar modelos de Inteligencia Artificial.

[Nezumi: Quest for Redemption]

Nezumi, immersed in tending the plants, barely heard the footsteps approaching from the greenhouse entrance. She looked up at the approaching steps and there he was, the Kazekage, calm as the desert, with a faint tension in his face.

— I... didn't expect to see you here today, — she said, surprised, a small smile touching her lips as Gaara approached her table.

In his hands were two neatly folded paper tickets; he held them out to her.

— These are invitations to the “Allied Reunion Evening,” where all the Kage, their close aides, and important guests gather, — Gaara said, pausing before he continued. — Will you agree to go with me?

Nezumi froze for a moment. Her heart quickened, embarrassment colored her cheeks, but a light came into her eyes. She could hardly believe it; appearing together before such high‑ranking company would be a significant step.

— Yes... I'll go, — she said softly, reaching for the ticket. — With you.

Their fingers brushed as the invitation passed between them, and Nezumi turned her face away, shy.

At her “yes,” the faint tension on Gaara’s face vanished, and a small smile of relief curved his lips.

— Then I’ll pick you up tomorrow.

Neji was angry. He had caught himself feeling strange once before, for example, when, while patrolling the classroom during a test, he stopped behind Gaara and involuntarily lingered his gaze on his neck, exposed under a loose hoodie. Then he quickly pulled himself together, because he was focused on his teaching role. But now, he didn’t expect a trick and was relaxed. The body reacted instantly.

In addition, he hadn’t had a close relationship in a long time. He approached teaching and graduate studies with full responsibility, he didn’t even have enough time for the obligatory ones, and he simply didn’t think about romantic relationships. Fleeting affairs are not in his nature. To top it off, he remembered that ridiculous kiss in my freshman year. Or rather, the boy’s face, with flushed cheeks, it is unclear whether from shame or resentment.

How he now wanted to trivialize the image of that youthful handsome face, to imagine it a little higher than his own knees. The next morning, he would hate himself for it, and Gaara would once again feel the cold and aloof tone in his voice. And if a gifted student really has a head on his shoulders, he will pack up and leave without waiting for the evening.

Vo svete Naruta sa síce pozornosť sústreďuje najmä na súboje a priateľstvá, no objavujú sa aj silné romantické príbehy. Medzi nimi vyniká tragický vzťah medzi Itachim Uchihom a Izumi, ktorý mnohí fanúšikovia ani nepoznajú. Ich puto začalo nenápadne počas školských čias, keď si Izumi obľúbila tichého a talentovaného chlapca. Postupne sa zblížili, hoci Itachi si svoje emócie nechával často pre seba.

S pribúdajúcimi povinnosťami a rastúcim napätím v klane Uchiha sa ich stretnutia stávali čoraz vzácnejšími. Situácia vyústila do tragédie počas masakru klanu, keď Itachi dostal úlohu zabrániť vojne za každú cenu. Izumi sa stala jeho prvou obeťou, no zároveň aj osobou, ktorej chcel dopriať pokojný koniec.

Pred sm*ťou jej pomocou schopnosti Mangekyo Sharingan daroval ilúziu spoločného života. V nej prežili roky ako partneri, založili rodinu a dožili sa staroby. Pre Izumi tak vznikol sen naplnený láskou, zatiaľ čo realita priniesla krátky, no o to silnejší moment rozlúčky.

Anime verzia tento príbeh zmenila a jej sm*ť pripísala inej postave, čím pripravila fanúšikov o jednu z najemotívnejších scén. Napriek tomu zostáva Itachiho príbeh stále symbolom obety, bolesti a nenaplnenej lásky.

Heute gibt es mal wieder was von Naruto 😁 und zwar Itachi Uchiha von Pickstar Studios. Und was soll man sagen ,die Statue ist einfach eine Wucht. Was Pickstar Studios hier mal wieder gezaubert hat, ist Next Level. 

Vom Mond bis hin zu Itachi selber,  einfach alles perfekt bemalt und die Beleuchtung ist der Hammer .( Der Mond ist ganz schön schwer 😂)
Mit Fernbedienung verstellbar von Rot zu Weiß und in Itachis Kopf ein Schalter für die roten Augen .

Happy Valentine’s Day!💕
情人節是必須留給鳴與佐的🥰
今年也是畫第七班時期的他們🥷🏻
-
「混蛋，不要走。」
當我在思考畫些甚麼來為他們慶祝情人節時，
突然想到，如果鳴在知道佐要離村時，
以這種方式挽留的話會怎樣😆
佐應該會心軟和猶豫多幾十秒吧﹖😆
畢竟是初吻對象🤣（﹖）
「我絕不會眼睜睜的看著你去那種地方送死﹗」
「我一定要阻止你﹗」
「我不會把你交給大蛇丸的﹗」
「我是不會讓你走的﹗」
「你該給我清醒了﹗否則我就真的要把你硬生生的拖回去﹗」
在終結之谷講盡了千言萬語，
其實想表達的都只是﹕
「不要走，我想你留下來，我怕你會在我看不到的地方有甚麼危險，怕得要死。」
欸不是，突然覺得這幅畫不是糖，好像藏著刀🥲🔪
不管了，反正他們本來就是苦戀💔
祝大家的CP都情人節快樂!!🎉🫶🏻
去年畫了腳、今年畫了手，
明年還能畫的話畫甚麼好呢﹖☺️
PS. 最後想說，手好難畫﹗﹗﹗🤯

Toisessa matsissa Oskaria vastaan sain hankittua muutaman pisteen mutta ei riittänyt. Omalta osalta hieno kokemus ja mitään Amerikan temppuja ei osattu vielä et täytyy parantaa omaa temppupankkia. [Akatsuki AU]  WHO'S THAT POKÉMON ⁉️
yessss he's back again baby 🕶️
I know that most people that are here for primarily Naruto stuff have missed this idiot, and honestly so have I - I've just been extremely down in the dumps lately, but I'm forcing myself to look on the bright side.

In this AU, Ringo's search for Kisame goes a bit differently - he flees Kirigakure but his journey doesn't get interrupted by Orochimaru. Instead, he becomes a wanderer, somewhat of a traveling mercenary. He finds Zabuza's sword far before Suigetsu would even know about it still being out there and goes on his merry way. It didn't take more than a few short years for him to catch up to the Akatsuki, and at first he really wasn't welcome - hell, even Kisame himself wanted him gone in a way. But after hearing and seeing what he'd gone through in order to find them, they couldn't quite reject him. He was a tough nut to crack, and could prove useful as long as he didn't stand in anyone's way. Ringo seems pretty content with his life in the akatsuki, though he's secretly envious of regular shinobi his age with their teams and senseis, quietly yearning for an experience like that. Other than the lack of friends he's mostly happy, remaining as bright and friendly as his canon counterpart but with less trauma and a bit more confidence.

His shark form is still present, except he has way better control of it than the canon one. It's still rarely used though and requires Samehada to activate (which Kisame doesn't lend him very often, much to Ringo's annoyance).

“Double Diamond ဆိုတာဘာလဲ”

“Double Diamond ဆိုတာဘာလဲ” ဆိုပြီး မေးလာတဲ့ ကာကာလေးတွေအတွက် ရှင်းရှင်းလင်းလင်း သိသွားအောင် မင်မင်က ရှင်းပြပေးမယ်နော်။

✨Double Diamond ဆိုတာ ဘာလဲ?

အရိုးရှင်းဆုံး ပြောရရင် Double Diamond ဆိုတာက ကိုယ်ဝယ်ယူလိုက်တဲ့ Diamond ပမာဏအတိုင်း အပိုလက်ဆောင် (Bonus) အနေနဲ့ နောက်ထပ်တစ်ဆ ထပ်ရတာကို ဆိုလိုတာပါ။

ဥပမာ - ကာကာလေးတို့က Double Diamond ၁၅၀+၁၅၀ ဝယ်လိုက်တယ်ဆိုရင် ဈေးကတော့ Diamond ၁၅၀ ဈေးပါဘဲ။ ဒါပေမယ့် မူရင်း Diamond ၁၅၀ အပြင် Game ကနေ Bonus ၁၅၀ ထပ်ပေးပြီး စုစုပေါင်း Diamond ၃၀၀ ရရှိမှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

✨Double Diamond ဘယ်နှမျိုးရှိလဲ?

MLBB ရဲ့ Shop (Recharge Section) မှာ ပုံမှန်အားဖြင့် Double Diamond ရနိုင်တဲ့ Package (၄) မျိုး ရှိပါတယ်။

50 + 50 Double Diamonds
150 + 150 Double Diamonds
250 + 250 Double Diamonds
500 + 500 Double Diamonds

✨ဘယ်လိုအချိန်မှာရမှာလဲ?

ဂိမ်းထဲက Shop ထဲက Diamond ထဲမှာ “First Recharge Bonus” ဆိုတဲ့ အနီစာတန်းလေး ပြနေမှသာ ရရှိမှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်

✨သိထားရမယ့် “တစ်ခါစီပဲ ရမယ်” ဆိုတဲ့ စည်းကမ်း

ဒီ Double Diamond အခွင့်အရေးဟာ Package တစ်ခုကို တစ်ကြိမ်စီပဲ ခံစားခွင့်ရှိတာပါ။

ဥပမာ - 150 + 150 ကို တစ်ခါဝယ်ပြီးပြီဆိုရင် နောက်တစ်ခါ အဲဒီ package ကိုဖြည့်တဲ့အခါ Bonus Diamond ပြန်မရတော့ဘဲ ပုံမှန် Diamond 150 အတိုင်းပဲ ရတော့မှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

ဒါပေမဲ့ ကျန်နေသေးတဲ့ 50, 250, 500 တန် Package တွေကိုတော့ Double အနေနဲ့ တစ်ခါစီ ထပ်ဝယ်လို့ ရပါသေးတယ်။

✨Event Recharge အတွက် ဘာလို့ အရေးကြီးတာလဲ?

ဂိမ်းထဲမှာ Event တွေ လာတဲ့အခါ “Recharge 250 Diamonds” ဆိုတဲ့ Task တွေကို ဖြည့်ကြရတယ်မဟုတ်လား။ အဲဒီအချိန်မှာ Double Diamond Package ကို ဝယ်လိုက်မယ်ဆိုရင် တစ်ချက်ခုတ် နှစ်ချက်ပြတ် ပါပဲ။ Event Task လည်း အောင်သလို၊ Diamond ကလည်း အပို (Bonus) ပါရမှာမို့ Draw လှည့်ဖို့အတွက် အရမ်းကို တန်တဲ့ နည်းလမ်းလေးပါ။ အဲတာမို့ Event Recharge Task တွေ ရှိတဲ့အချိန်တွေမှာ ဒီ Double Diamond Package တွေကို ဝယ်ယူတာက ပိုကောင်းပါတယ်။

ဒီလောက်ဆိုရင်တော့ Double Diamond အကြောင်းကို ကာကာလေးတို့ ရှင်းလင်းသွားမယ်လို့ ယူဆပါတယ်နော်။ ကိုယ့်ရဲ့ အကောင့်မှာ Double Diamond ကျန်/မကျန် သိချင်ရင်လည်း မင်မင်တို့ဆီမှာ Screenshot ပြပြီး မေးမြန်းဝယ်ယူနိုင်ပါတယ်!

2026.02.10 心斎橋 #火影 

個人的にマイブラより楽しみにしていたイボイボ大全行ってきました。京都大阪に来てくれるなんて嬉しすぎます。初イボイボで火影に行くのは10年以上ぶりぐらいでした。 

もうとにかく楽しかったです！ 

演奏の3人ではじまって掟さんが後で登場するのですが、私の横の横あたりからステージに登場した掟さんと例のお人形さんにもぉ～大興奮でした。前で見れたのでよく見えましたが掟さんの細かな表情や手の動きもステキでした。長い髪をふり演奏しコーラスする森川さんも迫力がありました。はじめてライブで見たのですがカワグチさんもイトケンさんもかっこよかったです！ 

新しいアルバムもよかったので
いつかまた来てくれたらとても嬉しいです。 

対バンのsilentheadさんもBLONDnewHALFさんも素敵でした！ 

さて、会場進呈のハイパーリミックスバージョンなのですがQRコードをスマホに取り込むと音楽が流れたので保存もされていると勘違いしてしまいました。帰ったらどこにも保存されていなくてショック！わたしはあほや

先日、5年目以下の若手向けグループ「Ember（エンバー）」の第3回症例検討会を開催しました🔥
​今回は2名の先生に登壇いただき、非常に濃い学びの時間となりました。

🧑‍⚕️ 矢野 拓也 先生 @yano_takuya_ 
「智歯抜歯とチームビルディング」
判断基準と手技のリアルなコツ。明日からの外科が変わるような内容でマネジメントの考え方まで非常に勉強になりました。

🧑‍⚕️ 横山 惟子 先生
​「口腔機能低下症をみること」
検査と診断のポイントを徹底解説。これからの歯科に必須の視点で興味をもつことができました！

​講師の先生方、参加いただいた皆さま、本当にありがとうございました。

Emberは、
「卒後5年以内の若手が、“明日からやってみたい”と思える学びをシェアする場所」
としてつくったスタディグループです。

🔥Ember（エンバー）🔥

臨床の悩み、将来の不安、アウトプットの壁など「卒後数年のもやもや期」を過ごす卒後5年目までの若手歯科医師同士で、“火種を持ち寄り、互いに火を灯し合う“グループです。
⸻
💬Emberとは？
SSSの5年目以下の若手メンバーが対象の、「学びと対話」「成長とつながり」をテーマにしたグループ活動です。
経験年数の近い仲間と日々の悩みを共有し、成長し合うことを目的にしています。
・2カ月に1回、気軽な症例共有＆ディスカッション
・発表が苦手でもOK！スライドテンプレートやサポートを準備しています。
⸻
🧭こんな方に
・身近に相談できる仲間がいない
・プレゼン経験を積みたいけど不安
・同じ温度感の歯科医とつながりたい
・臨床だけでなく「志」も共有したい
⸻
一人では消えそうな火も、仲間がいれば絶えない。
くすぶる日も、誰かと話せば前を向ける。
そんな“居場所”と“刺激”が、Emberにはあります。
EmberからFlameへ──。ここから一緒に。

caption:
Finally Suyou is released in the main server and he is a really OP new jungler/assassin in the game! 

I love playing this new hero Suyou because one his design is similar to Naruto, he has a Susanoo-like form as well in the game and if we get a Naruto collab, Sasuke will be the skin for Suyou! His skills are similar to Sasuke's Susanoo's as well when he uses his charged form, first skill on his charged form is a spear charge which stuns the enemy, second skill on his charged form is a double blade slash which hits enemies around him and deals more damage and his charged form ultimate is an long-range arrow similar to Yi Sun Shin but deals a lot of damage! 

His skills on tap is also really strong, first skill is a dash and slashes the enemy and you can use this to chase or escape from enemies who are chasing you! Second skill is an aoe blast and you can combo this skill with skill 1 to burst the enemy hero! And his ultimate on tap is backward slash which is good for avoiding skill attacks too! 

But what I like about Suyou the most is that he has a lot of different combos and he's more fun to play than Julian in my opinion! He's just a really unique and OP new hero and can be played either in jungle or XP! 

I use full damage build for jungle and hybrid tank and damage for XP! 

I bought his skin as well which is only 55 diamonds, overall Suyou is a really strong new hero in the game and he is a mechanically-skilled hero too, quite difficult to master at the start but he's really OP once you master him!  The best new hero in the game in my opinion, his combos are just insanely good!

~ LOANA [1977 • 2026]

C’est triste mais ça faisait si longtemps que c’était triste. Mais ça rend triste. Et tous ceux qui l’ont aimée et avaient défendu cette chose non reproductible indéfiniment qu’était Le Loft — très réticente d’abord j’ai fini par écrire dessus dans La lettre du cinéma (!) — contrairement à ce qu’on avait pu croire (que ce serait plein de fois la première fois, mais non), sentent bien qu’ils ont une responsabilité à cette tristesse. Je me rappelle qu’un cinéaste à l’époque avait émis le désir de la faire tourner : Laurent Achard. J’ai vraiment attendu le film. Moins celui de Achard que celui de Loana. Ce film n’existe pas. Il reste quoi ? La fin d’un truc qui s’appelait la télé et qu’on a été plusieurs à imaginer comme un début. On s’est trompés. Loana en est la preuve cuisante. C’était la fin de la starlette. Viendraient les influenceuses qui n’ont rien à voir avec ça je crois. Loana c’était le crépuscule du gaze.

Dünyanın gözü önünde, modern çağın tüm "insan hakları" nutuklarını yerle bir eden bir vahşet sergileniyor. 18 aylık bir bebeğin bedeninde sigara yanıkları ve kesici alet izleri aramak, sadece bir savaş suçu değil; bu, insanlığın bittiği, vicdanın kokuştuğu en uç noktadır.
​Bir babaya diz çöktürmek, onu konuşturmak ya da iradesini kırmak için bir bebeğe işkence etmek, hiçbir askeri stratejiyle, hiçbir güvenlik gerekçesiyle açıklanamaz. Bu, saf bir kötülüktür. Bebeklerin "rehine" olarak kullanıldığı, çocukların bedenlerinin birer psikolojik harp sahasına çevrildiği bir dünyada, medeniyetten bahsetmek ikiyüzlülüktür.
​Bugün o bebeğin vücudundaki yaralar, sadece bir ailenin değil, tüm insanlığın utanç vesikasıdır. Bu zulme sessiz kalan her kurum, bu vahşeti görmezden gelen her merci, o suç aletini tutan eller kadar sorumludur. Masum bir bebeğin gözyaşında boğulan bir dünya, adaletten ve onurdan söz edemez.
​Tarih, sadece yapılanları değil; bu vahşet karşısında susanları da en ağır şekilde yargılayacaktır.

"Sakın, Allah’ı zalimlerin yaptıklarından habersiz sanma! Allah, onları ancak gözlerin dehşetle dışarı fırlayacağı bir güne erteliyor." (İbrahim, 14/42)

Într-un interviu acordat revistei @energynomics, directorul executiv al ACUE, @danaralucadaraban, a vorbit despre ordonanța prin care se menține sprijinul pentru plata facturilor la gaze pentru consumatorii casnici până la 1 aprilie 2027, despre necesitatea unor măsuri coerente pentru protecția consumatorilor vulnerabili și funcționarea eficientă a sectorului energetic.
Principalele idei exprimate:
▫️ Este nevoie de măsuri concrete pentru creșterea lichidității pe piețele angro de gaze, esențială pentru formarea unor prețuri competitive și pentru stabilitatea sectorului energetic. Piața are nevoie de mai multe tranzacții și de cantități mai mari disponibile la vânzare pentru a genera semnale de preț credibile. 
▫️ Anul de tranziție până în aprilie 2027 nu trebuie pierdut; mecanismul de protecție țintită pentru consumatorii vulnerabili trebuie consolidat și perfecționat. Pe termen mediu și lung este nevoie de o strategie asumată pentru încălzirea rezidențială, cu reducerea dependenței de lemn și promovarea alternativelor eficiente și mai puțin poluante.
▫️ Sectorul energetic se confruntă cu un nivel ridicat de fiscalitate și taxe suplimentare care afectează predictibilitatea investițiilor. Trebuie să decidem dacă tratăm sectorul energetic ca sursă suplimentară de venituri la buget sau ca motor al investițiilor într-un sistem energetic modern și competitiv.
▫️ Investițiile în rețele nu sunt costuri pasive, ci facilitatori ai competitivității economice și ai tranziției energetice. Dezvoltarea noilor tehnologii și digitalizarea sistemului energetic cresc responsabilitățile operatorilor de rețea și complexitatea activității acestora.

Brincadeiras à parte, quis trazer o Itachi como uma alusão a algo que aparece com muita frequência na clínica: pessoas que cresceram tendo decisões importantes tomadas por elas, sob a justificativa de que aquilo era “para o seu bem”.

Quando não há espaço para escolha, erro e escuta, o impacto vai além da situação. Isso pode dificultar a confiança nas próprias decisões, aumentar o medo de errar e gerar necessidade de validação externa.

Na vida adulta, isso aparece como indecisão, dificuldade de se posicionar, medo de desagradar e até confusão sobre o que você realmente quer.

Não é sobre falta de amor. Muitas vezes há intenção de proteger.
Mas proteção sem escuta pode gerar insegurança em vez de autonomia.

Julian de Cato Kusters

"Fleur et Julian tombent follement amoureuses et décident de se marier dans chaque pays où leur union peut être légalement reconnue. Portées par leur amour et leur engagement, elles s’élancent cœur et âme dans ce projet. Mais après seulement quatre mariages, leur parcours va s’interrompre brusquement…"

Inspiré de l'histoire vraie de l'artiste belge Fleur Pierets et de son livre "Julian", le film oscille entre le documentaire et la fiction avec son traitement des images en caméscope. On a vraiment l'impression que les actrices sont le vrai couple.

Une histoire d'amour qui commence avec un échange de regard et qui continue par un projet incroyable et magnifique : se marier dans les 22 pays où le mariage gay est légal en 2018. Un projet génial et original, militant et qui a envie de montrer au monde entier que tous les amours se valent, que c'est le même amour qui unit les êtres.

Une motivation très forte vu que cela va avoir des conséquences sur leurs vies pro qu'elles doivent mettre entre parenthèses.

On suit la préparation, on a une idée de l'état de l'intolérance de la planète. 22 pays c'est peu...

Un projet fort et symbolique stoppé net...

Une histoire d'amour bouleversante portée par deux actrices qui se complètent, l'une est plutôt angoissée, l'autre est plus chill même dans la maladie.

Je n'ai pas trop aimé le côté éclaté de la mise en scène qui mélange toute la chronologie et j'ai trouvé que parfois ça restait trop vague mais une histoire forte.

Relectura para terminar (al fin) la trilogía.
La primera vez que lo leí, me enojé por el final y detuve todo. Ahora, después de más de 3 años y habiendo leido otros libros del estilo, no me alucinó al mismo nivel.
La construcción del mundo es impecable, con reglas bien explicadas y un juego muy intrigante. Stephanie sabe como atraer la atención del lector. 
Por otra parte, los personajes no me generaron tanta empatía hasta el final, donde ocurren los grandes plot-twist del libro, pero eso no evito que disfrutara de ellos. 

Un libro que, quizás debido a la relectura, no me impresionó, pero con un fuerte potencial para los siguientes numeros.

👨‍🏭 A empresa de serviços industriais Priner registrou um crescimento de 17% na receita bruta no primeiro trimestre de 2026 em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado, segundo a prévia operacional divulgada nesta segunda-feira (6).

Apesar desse avanço, a receita apresentou uma queda de 10,2% em relação ao quarto trimestre de 2025, refletindo ajustes sazonais e variações operacionais do período.

Entre janeiro e março, a Priner celebrou contratos que somam R$ 1,42 bilhão com 13 empresas diferentes, incluindo grandes nomes como Vale, Anglo American, Prio, Suzano, Unipar e Usiminas Mineração, reforçando sua presença e diversificação no setor de serviços industriais.

📰 Fonte: Valor Econômico

Compartilhar conhecimento e fortalecer a cultura de inovação faz parte do nosso propósito.

No dia 06 de abril, a TSA marcou presença no Programa Atitude Responsável, promovido pela Vale, no CTF – Centro de Tecnologia de Ferrosos.

A solução apresentada pelo Coordenador de Projeto Keoma Cavalcante e Gerente Alexandre Almeida — baseada em digitalização rápida, visualização integrada e processamento automatizado em nuvem — mostrou como é possível trazer a planta para dentro do escritório, permitindo que equipes multidisciplinares naveguem pelos ambientes com alto nível de precisão, colaboração e entendimento técnico. Em vez de depender exclusivamente de levantamentos tradicionais, a tecnologia reduz retrabalhos, acelera a tomada de decisão e eleva a qualidade dos projetos entregues. Mais do que capturar imagens, a ferramenta amplia a capacidade de análise, facilita o diagnóstico de interferências, apoia treinamentos, fortalece a confiabilidade operacional e cria um repositório digital estruturado para gestão de ativos — tudo com foco em segurança, eficiência e evolução contínua.

No Grupo TSA, seguimos comprometidos em impulsionar a digitalização industrial e apoiar nossos clientes na construção de operações mais inteligentes, conectadas e orientadas por dados.

🔥 Zwei Ninja. Zwei Wege. Ein episches Erbe, das dein Herz zerreißt.

In meinem neuen Artikel auf alexstruever.com geht’s darum, wie Naruto uns zeigt, dass Loyalität, Rache und Freundschaft nicht nur Geschichten sind – sondern Spiegel dessen, wer wir werden könnten. Naruto kämpft, um anerkannt zu werden. Sasuke, um seinen Schmerz zu rächen. Zwei Wege, die sich kreuzen – und trotzdem grundverschieden bleiben. 

🌀 Was du im Artikel erfährst:

Wie sich Naruto von Ausgestoßener zum Leuchtturm der Hoffnung entwickelt, trotz aller Widrigkeiten. 

Wie Sasuke durch Verlust und Schuld in die Schatten gezogen wird – und was sein Weg über Mitgefühl und Selbstreflexion verrät. 

Warum „der Weg des Ninjas“ nicht nur Kampf bedeutet, sondern Entscheidungen, Verantwortung, Freundschaft. 

Und was wir heute noch von dieser Geschichte lernen können – Mut, Loyalität & die Kraft, Licht in der Dunkelheit zu finden. 

👉 Neugierig? Lies den Artikel auf alexstruever.com und tauche ein in die zwei Wege, die Naruto und Sasuke gehen. 
🔗 https://alexstruever.com/naruto-zwei-geschichten-zwei-wege-fantasy-anime-erleben/

💭 Deine Gedanken bitte:

Wenn du an ihrer Stelle wärst — welchen Weg würdest du wählen?
Und: Was war für dich in Naruto der Moment, wo du gemerkt hast – diese Geschichte ist mehr als Action & Ninja-Technik?

Di bawah langit musim semi yang cerah, bunga sakura mekar dengan anggun, menebarkan warna merah muda yang lembut di setiap sudut taman. Setiap kelopak yang jatuh seolah bercerita tentang keindahan yang sementara,mengingatkan kita untuk menghargai momen yang ada, karena waktu terus berjalan. 🌸

Bunga sakura bukan hanya sekadar bunga; mereka adalah simbol harapan, pembaruan, dan perjalanan hidup. Saat kita berdiri di bawah pohon sakura yang mekar, udara terasa lebih ringan, hati lebih damai, dan jiwa seolah tersentuh oleh kedamaian alam. Setiap helai kelopak yang menari di angin mengajarkan kita bahwa keindahan sejati ada dalam kesederhanaan, dan setiap akhir adalah awal yang baru.

Momen ini adalah pengingat bahwa hidup itu indah, meski sementara. Nikmatilah setiap detik, hargai setiap warna, dan biarkan hatimu mekar seperti bunga sakura yang anggun ini. ✨

Ich sag’s ehrlich: Viele alkoholfreie oder -arme Biere landen bei mir oft nicht leer im Glas – einfach, weil geschmacklich häufig etwas fehlt.

Dieses hier macht es aber deutlich besser: schön leicht und schlank, mit einer angenehmen malzigen Süße. Der Abgang ist dezent hopfig und sorgt zumindest für ein kleines bisschen Bier-Feeling.

Trotzdem bleibt es für mich eher ein solider Durstlöscher als ein echtes Genussbier. Für zwischendurch oder nach dem Sport absolut okay – aber ich greife dann doch lieber zur klassischen Variante.

Instituto Neurológico impulsa terapias para niños con autismo con trueque Kalea 2026

El Instituto Neurológico de Guatemala y Kalea anuncian una nueva edición de Trueque Kalea 2026, una campaña que promueve la donación de muebles usados para beneficiar terapias y programas de atención para niños con autismo.

La campaña Trueque Kalea 2026 se llevará a cabo hasta el 5 de abril. Las familias podrán donar muebles en tiendas Kalea o enviar fotografías para su evaluación. Como incentivo, los participantes recibirán un porcentaje de descuento en la compra de nuevos productos, mientras que los artículos recolectados serán destinados al Bazar del Mueble Usado del Instituto Neurológico de Guatemala.

I love how this window-treatment resonates with the architecture of the beautiful lakeside cottage, and how it blends in with the art inside and the nature around, while presenting a clear “no-go” for the birds, successfully breaking the deadly reflections and the see-through situation. 
It was last spring when I tailored this individual window design for a window situation that had recently taken the life of a hawk and a songbird… Sigh! (when birds are in such speed, in such chase, when life is already in danger, two windows across of each other can be the perfect architectural scenario for broken glass, broken wings, broken lives). 
I choose an excerpt of Mary Oliver’s poem “Invitation”, from her book “A Thousand Mornings” (2013). It talks about her observation of a gathering of goldfinches, - her words a feast for my thoughts - . I choose an excerpt, hand-wrote it fitting the size of the window, and got my design printed and installed by Feather Friendly. 
If you are contemplating a site specific, artistic window design, reach out to me directly or to Daniel Faria Gallery.
