Entre silencios, Sakura lo encontró sin buscarlo.

—Sabía que estabas cerca…

Sasuke salió de entre los árboles. No había intención de atacar, pero tampoco cercanía.

—Deberías irte —dijo, tranquilo.

—No vine a pelear.

Sus miradas se cruzaron. No había odio, solo distancia y algo que ninguno quería nombrar.

Sakura dio un paso.

—No intento detenerte —murmuró ella—. Solo quiero entenderte.

Sasuke desvió la mirada un instante.

—No es necesario.

—Para mí sí.

El silencio se volvió más suave que incómodo.

Sakura levantó la mano y tocó su brazo con cuidado. Él no la apartó.

—No tienes que estar solo —susurró.

Sasuke cerró los ojos apenas, como si ese gesto pesara más que cualquier batalla.

—Y tú no deberías seguir viniendo.

Sakura sonrió leve.

—Aun así, lo hago.

Él la miró de verdad esta vez.

Y sin decir nada, se inclinó un poco.

El b3so fue breve.

Casi un roce.

Pero suficiente.

Cuando se separaron, el momento quedó suspendido entre ellos.

—Debo irme —dijo Sasuke.

—Lo sé.

Él dudó un segundo.

—Cuídate.

Sakura asintió.

—Tú también.
💕🔥✨

-Tawis

Quelle belle idée a eu @catokusters d'avoir raconté cette passion amoureuse, inspirée de l'histoire vraie de Fleur et Julian. Un geste politique et artistique fort ! À l'affiche, deux actrices magnifiques, Nina Meurisse 💖, comme toujours époustouflante et en face Laurence Roothooft, une actrice belge épatante. Et une mise en scène ultra sensitive, à fleur de peau, qui ne suit pas la chronologie du récit, qui fait la part belle à la puissance de l'amour et ses fragilités ! 😍💖🥺💔🩷🧡💛💚💙🩵💜

ตัวละครจากมังงะและอนิเมะเรื่อง Naruto (นินจาคาถาโอ้โฮเฮะ) ครับ โดยมีสองคนในภาพคือ:

อุจิวะ อิทาจิ (Uchiha Itachi): คนทางขวาที่เป็นคนพูดประโยคในภาพ

อุจิวะ ซาสึเกะ (Uchiha Sasuke): คนทางซ้ายที่เป็นน้องชาย

ฉากนี้เป็นฉากที่โด่งดังและสะเทือนใจมากที่สุดฉากหนึ่งในเรื่อง ซึ่งเป็นตอนที่อิทาจิได้บอกความจริงและแสดงความรักต่อซาสึเกะเป็นครั้งสุดท้ายครับ โดยข้อความภาษาไทยในภาพแปลมาจากประโยคภาษาอังกฤษที่ว่า "I will always love you" นั่นเอง

คุณบอกว่า
ฉันหมายถึง 2 ตัวนี้ชื่ออะไรบ้างแล้วจุดเด่นคืออะไร

Gemini บอกว่า
ตัวละครทั้งสองคือพี่น้องตระกูล อุจิวะ (Uchiha) จากเรื่อง Naruto ครับ แต่ละคนมีจุดเด่นที่น่าสนใจและเป็นเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว ดังนี้ครับ

1. อุจิวะ อิทาจิ (Uchiha Itachi) — คนพี่ (ขวา)
อิทาจิถูกยกย่องว่าเป็นอัจฉริยะที่หาตัวจับยากที่สุดคนหนึ่งในหมู่บ้านโคโนฮะ

จุดเด่นด้านพลัง:

เนตรวงแหวนกระจกเงาหมื่นบุปผา (Mangekyo Sharingan): เขาสามารถใช้คาถาลวงตาที่รุนแรงที่สุดอย่าง "อ่านจันทรา" และไฟสีดำที่ไม่มีวันดับอย่าง "เทวีสุริยา"

เทพวายุ (Susanoo): ของอิทาจิมีความพิเศษตรงที่มี "ดาบโทสึกะ" ที่สามารถสะกดทุกอย่างได้ และ "กระจกยตะ" ที่สะท้อนการโจมตีได้ทุกรูปแบบ

จุดเด่นด้านบุคลิก: เป็นคนใจเย็น คิดการณ์ไกล และยอมเสียสละทุกอย่างแม้กระทั่งชื่อเสียงและชีวิตของตัวเองเพื่อปกป้องหมู่บ้านและน้องชาย

2. อุจิวะ ซาสึเกะ (Uchiha Sasuke) — คนน้อง (ซ้าย)
ซาสึเกะคือตัวเอกคู่ขนานที่มีพัฒนาการด้านพลังอย่างก้าวกระโดดตลอดทั้งเรื่อง

จุดเด่นด้านพลัง:

ธาตุสายฟ้าและไฟ: ท่าไม้ตายที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์คือ "พันปักษา" (Chidori) และเขายังพัฒนาไปถึงขั้นเรียกสายฟ้าจากธรรมชาติอย่าง "กิเลน" (Kirin)

เนตรสังสาระ (Rinnegan): ในภายหลังเขาได้รับเนตรสังสาระที่ตาซ้าย ทำให้สามารถสลับตำแหน่งวัตถุและใช้พลังในระดับพระเจ้าได้

จุดเด่นด้านบุคลิก: มีความมุ่งมั่นสูง (มักถูกขับเคลื่อนด้วยความแค้นในตอนแรก) เป็นคนเงียบขรึม และมีสไตล์การต่อสู้ที่เน้นความรวดเร็วและแม่นยำ

Don’t get caught in the "Performance Plug" trap. 🛠️

​During a full ignition inspection on the B-King, I discovered the original plugs had been swapped for so-called "performance" alternatives. Here’s the reality: on a bike with a license plate and mirrors, you aren’t always riding at the limit.

​When you chase a tiny gain on a street-ridden bike, you often end up losing. Without consistent high-rev heat cycles to burn off carbon deposits, these plugs can't "self-clean." The result? Fouled electrodes and poor throttle response. 📉

​We’re going back to the factory-spec NGK CR9EIA-9 Laser Iridium. While some might think the CR9EIX is an upgrade, the EIA-9 is specifically engineered for this 1340cc engine with a platinum-chip ground electrode and a precise 0.9mm gap. It’s designed for longevity and a clean burn, even when you aren't at redline. 🍬

​The Lesson: Stick to the engineering. We’re restoring this beast to run as crisp as the day it left the factory. ⚡️

SEIKO PRESENTA EL RELOJ DE EDICIÓN LIMITADA SHINKANSE HENKEI ROBO SHINKALION, PROTAGONIZADA POR HATSUNE MIKU

El reloj “Shinkansen Henkei Robo Shinkalion: H5 Hayabusa 10th Anniversary Watch” celebra el décimo aniversario de la serie de robots transformables destacando el Shinkalion H5 Hayabusa, que fue pilotado por un personaje inspirado en la popular cantante virtual, con la que compartía nombre.

Entre las referencias ocultas incluyen una cruz especial en la posición de las 10 en punto para celebrar el aniversario y un índice en la posición de las 12 en punto con la forma de la cresta de la cabeza del robot.

La producción está estrictamente limitada a 5.000 unidades en todo el mundo, lo que la convierte en un artículo de colección raro para los fanáticos del anime y de Hatsune Miku.

El reloj conmemorativo tiene un precio de 65.780 yenes (aprox. 435,00 dólares).

⁡
⁡【3月の活動報告】⁡
⁡3/7~8 嵐田パーク遠征⁡・少し山形観光⁡
⁡山形県内にある嵐田パークにて合同トレーニングを行いました！⁡
⁡高難易度かつボリューミーすぎる1stステージの通し練習や、サーモンラダーの素早い連続上げにチャレンジし、メタメタにやられつつも動きの引き出しを1つ学べました💥⁡
⁡⁡
⁡一夜明けて、この日はかみのやま温泉付近を散策♨⁡
⁡足湯に入ったり、上山城を間近で見てきました！⁡
⁡さらに午後は東根市へと移動し、多田竜也さんの行きつけである「そばと酒 まるよし」さんでおいしい肉そばを頂きました😋⁡
⁡関西にはない濃い味の出汁を味わえて、冷えた身体も温まりました☀️⁡
⁡⁡
⁡3/15~17 サークル旅行(東京〜浜松)⁡⁡
⁡
⁡1日目⁡
⁡旅行の初めは、江戸川区内のパルクールジム「MISSION PARKOUR PARK TOKYO」⁡さんにて合同トレーニング💪⁡
経験の浅い動きの練習や、よく跳ねるトランポリンで前宙にもチャレンジ👏⁡
⁡少し移動して、夕方は3月末まで開催していた「赤坂ラリー・江戸佐助」にチャレンジ🔥⁡
⁡チャレンジし始めた時には景品受け取りの終了時間まで2時間ほどしかなく、「Tシャツは諦めるか……」となっていましたが、持ち前の頭脳を使って1時間半で完全制覇！無事Tシャツもゲットできました👍⁡
⁡⁡
⁡2日目⁡
⁡この日は3日目に備えて1日目の疲れを取る目的で、熱海を観光しました！⁡
海岸線のすぐ近くに高い山がそびえ立つ熱海の地形には、坂道ダッシュに使えそうな傾斜の強い坂がたくさん！⁡それを見て興奮してしまうメンバーもいれば、休息日にもかかわらず公園で雲梯をしてしまうメンバーもいて、京大SASUKEサークルとしての個性を強く感じました🤩
⁡⁡
⁡3日目⁡
⁡SASUKEサークルの旅行のしめといえば、セット練習しかありません！⁡
⁡というわけで、浜松市内の「神社パーク」にて合同トレーニングを行いました💪⁡
⁡神社パークでは、1stステージのほとんどのエリアを再現！⁡通し練習をはじめ、トランポリンの飛び方の研究や、他のほとんどのセットにはないスクリュードライバーの飛びつきなどが練習でき、貴重な機会となりました✨⁡
⁡トレーニング後には「さわやか」でハンバーグを頂きました😋⁡
⁡⁡
⁡3/29⁡ 黒虎道場セット練習⁡
⁡兵庫県内の黒虎道場にて、弊サークルがSASUKE甲子園からの出場を応援している大阪星光学院のメンバーとともにトレーニングを行いました！⁡
⁡彼らの運動能力はやはり凄まじく、対策が必要と考えている1stステージのエリアたちをかなり上達させていました👏⁡
⁡一方でこの大阪星光学院のOBでもある代表は、ハーネスをつけてサーモンラダーにチャレンジ🔥⁡⁡
⁡フォームは汚いですが、自己記録に並ぶ8段まであげることができました！⁡
⁡全員が個々のやりたいことをでき、充実したトレーニングとなりました😊⁡
⁡⁡
⁡ #京大SASUKEサークル ⁡
⁡ #SASUKE

Entre silencios, Sakura lo encontró sin buscarlo.

—Sabía que estabas cerca…

Sasuke salió de entre los árboles. No había intención de atacar, pero tampoco cercanía.

—Deberías irte —dijo, tranquilo.

—No vine a pelear.

Sus miradas se cruzaron. No había odio, solo distancia y algo que ninguno quería nombrar.

Sakura dio un paso.

—No intento detenerte —murmuró ella—. Solo quiero entenderte.

Sasuke desvió la mirada un instante.

—No es necesario.

—Para mí sí.

El silencio se volvió más suave que incómodo.

Sakura levantó la mano y tocó su brazo con cuidado. Él no la apartó.

—No tienes que estar solo —susurró.

Sasuke cerró los ojos apenas, como si ese gesto pesara más que cualquier batalla.

—Y tú no deberías seguir viniendo.

Sakura sonrió leve.

—Aun así, lo hago.

Él la miró de verdad esta vez.

Y sin decir nada, se inclinó un poco.

El b3so fue breve.

Casi un roce.

Pero suficiente.

Cuando se separaron, el momento quedó suspendido entre ellos.

—Debo irme —dijo Sasuke.

—Lo sé.

Él dudó un segundo.

—Cuídate.

Sakura asintió.

—Tú también.
💕🔥✨

No ambiente digital de 2026, a segurança da informação é tão vital quanto o uso de EPIs em campo. 

No nosso DSSMA semanal, a equipe do escritório parou para reforçar os protocolos de proteção digital, sob a condução da nossa colaboradora Anne Karoline Pereira Ferreira.

Tratar de Cibersegurança não é apenas uma questão técnica, é um compromisso com a integridade com os dados nossos e dos dos nossos clientes.

Os 3 Pilares da Nossa Vigilância:

Links e E-mails Suspeitos: O "phishing" (tentativa de fraude) é a causa de 90% das invasões. A orientação da Anne foi clara: se o remetente for duvidoso, o procedimento é não abrir e reportar.

Validação de Boletos e Dados: Erros ou divergências em nomes de beneficiários e códigos de barras são sinais de alerta. O zelo com os processos financeiros é parte da nossa excelência operacional.

Cuidado com a Procedência: A verificação de e-mails de fontes não oficiais protege não apenas o nosso servidor, mas toda a nossa rede de fornecedores e parceiros.

Agradecemos à Anne Karoline por trazer dados e alertas tão práticos. Na Watergeo, acreditamos que a tecnologia só é eficiente quando acompanhada de uma cultura de prevenção consciente.

Segurança se faz com atenção aos detalhes, seja no solo, na água ou na tela do computador.

Ó estações,
deslizam e retornam
como o sopro leve
sobre os veles 
adormecidos.

Canta o vento,
em secreta sintonia,
tecendo harmonias invisíveis
no azul profundo do céu.

No vale, a beleza repousa
como um segredo ancestral. 
O céu se ergue em silencio,
e o sol, em gesto íntimo
de amor, beija a face da terra.

Quanta vida irrompe,
latente, luminosa.
Contemplam meus olhos
este instante magico,
quase sagrado.

— Tiago Amaral

Some places are too beautiful to share.

This hidden sakura spot in Numazu is one of them.
Cherry blossoms, a quiet pagoda, and Mt. Fuji watching over the city at dusk.
It feels like stepping into a scene that still belongs to the locals.

Part of me wants to keep this place a secret.
But another part wants the world to see this gentle, unforgettable side of Numazu.

Not crowded.
Not famous.
Just quietly beautiful.

If you are looking for a different kind of Japan, you may find it here.

“Mono no aware” mengingatkan kita untuk selalu berbenah, karena “keindahan” itu itu bersifat fana, tidak kekal.
Sakura adalah kekaguman sekaligus kesedihan saat menyadari bahwa segala segala sesuatu -Keindahan alam,kehidupan dan moment- bersifat sementara dan akan berakhir.

Sakura udah mulai gugur sebelum sempat aku jalan-jalan dan berfoto cantik dibawahnya, hari-hari terus berlalu dengan aktivitas yang tak memberiku waktu untuk bersantai.

Tahun ini, hanya ini foto tentang aku dan 🌸 sakura, foto seadanya, tanpa rencana hanya foto yang ku ambil saat aku keluar rumah untuk berbelanja bahan makanan di supermarket. Akan ku simpan jadi kenangan kalau tahun 2026 aku punya foto bersama 🌸 sakura hanya di samping apato, tanpa baju cantik dan sepatu baru.
Mono no aware, semua akan berlalu kan? Jadi ga usah berlebihan, terimakasih sakura.

Chaque membre avait une histoire, une blessure, une raison d'en être arrivé là. C'est exactement ce qui fait que même aujourd'hui, des années après avoir terminé la série, j'y repense encore.

Tobirama tidak membenci Uchiha secara pribadi, tetapi ia memiliki ketidakpercayaan yang mendalam terhadap Uchiha sebagai kelompok politik dan militer, yang berakar pada pengamatannya terhadap dampak dari Kutukan Kebencian.

Ketakutan terhadap Kutukan Kebencian
Inti dari ketidakpercayaan Tobirama adalah pengetahuan dan pemahamannya tentang Noroi no Nikushimi. Ketika seorang Uchiha mengalami cinta atau kehilangan yang mendalam, emosi positif mereka dapat langsung berubah menjadi kebencian yang kuat, yang pada akhirnya memicu Sharingan.

Tobirama melihat ini sebagai ancaman politik yang nyata dan tidak stabil. Seorang Uchiha yang berpotensi menjadi pemimpin Konoha, jika mengalami kerugian emosional, bisa saja memicu Sharingan dan mengarahkan kebenciannya ke desa, seperti yang dilakukan Madara.

Tobirama, bersama Hashirama, adalah arsitek Konoha. Tujuannya adalah perdamaian. Untuk Uchiha, ia mengambil langkah-langkah yang ia yakini sebagai upaya integrasi, meskipun berujung buruk.

Tobirama mendirikan Kepolisian Militer Konoha dan menempatkan Uchiha sebagai pemimpinnya. Ini adalah upaya untuk memberikan Uchiha peran penting dalam desa dan rasa memiliki. Niat Tobirama di balik ini adalah untuk memanfaatkan keterampilan Uchiha demi kebaikan desa, mengarahkan fokus mereka pada hukum dan ketertiban.

Masalahnya, penempatan Uchiha sebagai Polisi Militer secara fisik mengasingkan mereka dari pusat pemerintahan desa. Karena kepolisian terletak di pinggiran desa, menjauhkan Uchiha dari politik tingkat tinggi, yang dilihat Uchiha sebagai upaya untuk meminggirkan mereka.

Dari sudut pandang Tobirama, tindakan ini adalah upaya pencegahan agar Uchiha tidak berada di posisi yang dapat dengan mudah melancarkan kudeta atau memengaruhi kebijakan. Ia melihatnya sebagai langkah rasional untuk menjaga stabilitas desa dari potensi konflik yang ditimbulkan oleh "Kutukan Kebencian."

His knowledge comes from experience, not formal training. He has learned through trial, observation, and necessity, focusing on what works rather than theory. He keeps his methods simple and efficient.

When Kagami returns from a mission with minor injuries, Sandman treats them without hesitation. He selects the right supplies, cleans the wounds, and applies the correct topicals. Cette adaptation du roman éponyme et autobiographique donne un premier long-métrage réussi de la jeune Cato Kusters. L’histoire est belle, émouvante et donne cruellement envie d’aimer. La puissance de l’amour entre Julian et Fleur réside entre autres dans les regards, les sourires et les rires. Ce film nous rappelle également à quel point il reste encore beaucoup de combats à mener car rien qu’en Europe, c’est près de la moitié des pays qui n’autorisent pas le mariage des personnes du même sexe. 

💡Lumière sur Nina Meurisse (Fleur) qui est toujours aussi époustouflante dans ses choix et ses interprétations.

Vu JULIAN, premier film de la réalisatrice belge Cato Kusters, qui adapte le roman autobiographique de Fleur Pierets où elle raconte sa rencontre avec Julian, leur amour fou, le projet qu’il a inspiré (se marier dans tous les pays ou le mariage homosexuel est autorisé) et la maladie qui l’a interrompu au bout de quatre cérémonies seulement. Le film insiste bien sûr sur l’aspect militant d’une telle démarche, entreprise aussi pour attirer l’attention sur les inégalités de traitement subies par la communauté LGBTQI + concernant le mariage, la PMA, l’adoption, etc. Mais c’est surtout le récit bouleversant d’un amour fauché par la maladie et le montage n’en fait pas mystère, alternant dès les premières minutes les séquences pré et post annonce du cancer foudroyant de Julian. Aucun pathos ici, ni défoulement lacrymal ou violon envahissant, juste la vérité brute de l’injustice et du chagrin. Les deux actrices qui portent ces personnages magnifiques le sont tout autant. Nina Meurisse (César du meilleur second rôle l’année dernière dans « L’Histoire de Souleymane » de Boris Lojkine) tout particulièrement. 👩‍❤️‍👩💍👰‍♀️

I AM NARUTO 🦊🔥

Not the loud kid you laughed at… not the failure you counted out… but the one who kept going when quitting would’ve been easier 💔➡️❤️‍🔥
Every scar, every lonely night, every “you can’t do it” built something unbreakable inside me ⚡

This isn’t just about power… it’s about never giving up when the world gives you every reason to 🥀
It’s about turning pain into purpose… doubt into fuel… and dreams into reality 🌙➡️🌅

I didn’t become strong overnight.
I became strong every time I chose to stand back up 💥
Every time I believed in myself… even when no one else did 🧠💭

So if you’re struggling right now… good.
That means your story is still being written 📖
And trust me—the best chapters come after the hardest battles ⚔️

Keep pushing. Keep believing. Keep fighting.
Because one day… they won’t recognize the version of you that refused to quit 🏆

Ember update. 🔥

Ember is getting a little more comfortable each day.

Just a few days ago, he didn’t have the strength to lift his head… now he’s claiming office space. 😊

Here at Suncoast Humane Society, we believe animals deserve time outside of kennels to relax, stretch, and just be themselves. Ember is no exception… although he may have upgraded to one of the coziest spots in the building, our leadership offices.

He’s been spending some time lounging on a big dog bed, getting plenty of rest while he continues to recover.

He’s still on his healing journey, but seeing him relaxed and comfortable like this is a really good sign.

Thank you to everyone who continues to cheer him on. 🐾

ចូលរួមព្រឹត្តិការណ៍ ការបង្វិលឈុតក្រៅ MLBB x NARUTO ដើម្បីមានឱកាសទទួលបានឈុតក្រៅផ្តាច់មុខថ្មីទាំងនេះ៖ Gusion "Minato Namikaze", Julian "Itachi Uchiha" និងរង្វាន់ផ្តាច់មុខផ្សេងទៀត! ធានាទទួលបានឈុតក្រៅ ឬធនធានសហការ ក្នុងការបង្វិល ១០ដងដំបូង!!!

ចូលរួមព្រឹត្តិការណ៍ដើម្បីផ្លាស់ប្តូរយក "Voucher of Flame" x៣, "Scroll of Flame" x៣, រូប Emote សហការ និងធនធានសហការមានកំណត់ផ្សេងទៀតនៅក្នុងហាង Bead!

Chcemy, abyście nosząc nasze projekty, czuły lekkość, witalność, autentyczną energię i radość życia. 🦋
Jeśli jest jakaś ważna dla Ciebie kobieta, która Cię inspiruje i wspiera to oczywiście oprócz wspólnego czasu i cieszenia się swoim towarzystwem, biżuteria z naturalnymi kamieniami jest zawsze świetnym pomysłem na prezent. 🩷
W związku z tym możesz już obdarować ją kartą podarunkową do naszego sklepu aby sama wybrała, która biżuteria najbardziej jej się podoba. 🤩

“Sorumlu Değiliz” Tabelası Hukuku Bağlamaz! Aracınız Emanetimizdir. 
Aracınızı yıkatmak için anahtarı bırakıp gittiniz, döndüğünüzde ise aracınızın kaza yaptığını veya çalındığını öğrendiniz. İşletme sahibi “Personelimiz izinsiz almış” veya “Tabelada yazdık, mesuliyet kabul etmiyoruz” diyorsa; onlara Türk Borçlar Kanunu’nu hatırlatın!
İşte Yıkamacı ve Otopark İşletmelerinin Kaçamayacağı Hukuki Sorumluluklar:
1.	Kusursuz Sorumluluk: Anahtarın teslim edilmesiyle birlikte işletmeci, aracı koruma borcu altına girer. Aracın başına gelen her türlü zarardan (çalışanının hatası olsun veya olmasın) işletme sahibi şahsen ve ticari olarak sorumludur.
2.	Tabelaların Geçersizliği: Girişe asılan “Sorumluluk kabul etmiyoruz” yazıları, tüketici hukukunda “Haksız Şart” sayılır ve mahkeme huzurunda hiçbir geçerliliği yoktur.
3.	Hangi Zararları İsteyebilirsiniz?
• Tamir Masrafları: Aracın eski haline getirilmesi için gereken bedel.
• Değer Kaybı: Aracın kazalı duruma düşmesi nedeniyle piyasa değerindeki azalma.
• İkame Araç Bedeli: Aracın tamirde kaldığı süre boyunca ulaşım için yaptığınız harcamalar.
4.	Hırsızlık Durumu: Araç yıkamacıdayken çalınırsa ve bulunamazsa; işletme, aracın güncel rayiç bedelini size nakden ödemek zorundadır.
Ne Yapmalısınız?
• Olay anında hemen Polis/Jandarma Tutanağı tutturun.
• Anahtarı teslim ettiğinize dair (varsa) kamera kayıtlarını veya fişi muhafaza edin.
• İşletmeye noter kanalıyla ihtar çekerek zararın karşılanmasını talep edin; aksi halde icra takibi ve tazminat davası açmaktan çekinmeyin.
“Emanet” hukukta kutsaldır. Aracınızı teslim ettiğiniz işletme, kendi malını koruduğundan daha fazla sizin malınızı korumakla yükümlüdür. Hakkınızı arayın!

Team 7 was a Konohagakure team formed under the leadership of Kakashi Hatake. Two-and-a-half years after Sasuke Uchiha left the village, Kakashi filled out paperwork to form Team Kakashi, with his former pupils Naruto Uzumaki and Sakura Haruno now being treated as equals alongside their teacher. Following Yamato and Sai joining the team, the group went by Team Yamato during the former's leadership.

Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura were organised into a team following their graduation from the Academy in order to balance out their talents: Naruto, the worst student in his class, would benefit from Sakura's intelligence and Sasuke's proficiency with ninjutsu; Sakura would benefit from her more battle-capable teammates; Sasuke would benefit from being forced to work with others. Kakashi was selected to lead them in order to keep an eye on Naruto, Nine-Tails' jinchūriki and, in the anime, to help Sasuke cope with life after the Uchiha Clan Downfall, and as well to develop his Sharingan. As with all the previous genin teams he was put in charge of, Kakashi gives them a bell test in order to determine if they give the proper importance to teamwork. Unlike all previous genin teams, Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura pass the test, considered prodigies with extraordinary potential.

Vo svete Naruta sa síce pozornosť sústreďuje najmä na súboje a priateľstvá, no objavujú sa aj silné romantické príbehy. Medzi nimi vyniká tragický vzťah medzi Itachim Uchihom a Izumi, ktorý mnohí fanúšikovia ani nepoznajú. Ich puto začalo nenápadne počas školských čias, keď si Izumi obľúbila tichého a talentovaného chlapca. Postupne sa zblížili, hoci Itachi si svoje emócie nechával často pre seba.

S pribúdajúcimi povinnosťami a rastúcim napätím v klane Uchiha sa ich stretnutia stávali čoraz vzácnejšími. Situácia vyústila do tragédie počas masakru klanu, keď Itachi dostal úlohu zabrániť vojne za každú cenu. Izumi sa stala jeho prvou obeťou, no zároveň aj osobou, ktorej chcel dopriať pokojný koniec.

Pred sm*ťou jej pomocou schopnosti Mangekyo Sharingan daroval ilúziu spoločného života. V nej prežili roky ako partneri, založili rodinu a dožili sa staroby. Pre Izumi tak vznikol sen naplnený láskou, zatiaľ čo realita priniesla krátky, no o to silnejší moment rozlúčky.

Anime verzia tento príbeh zmenila a jej sm*ť pripísala inej postave, čím pripravila fanúšikov o jednu z najemotívnejších scén. Napriek tomu zostáva Itachiho príbeh stále symbolom obety, bolesti a nenaplnenej lásky.

🟠🎢 Naruto 🎢🟠

Découverte du Land Naruto au parc spirou. Le parc est a 1h de la maison alors on a foncé découvrir ça depuis le temps ! On a suivis les travaux et toutes les vidéos des copains qui y étaient sur place 😉 on etait pas comme certain hypé on attendait de voir une fois sur place...

Très agréablement surprise, la zone est tellement belle, la boutique est superbe (un peu petite), le repas japonais😍 un méga point le parc spirou 🙏❤️ pas fan de Naruto mais une licence qu'on connais tous évidemment et cela fonctionne parfaitement. 

Bon kyubi le petit coaster familial est un familial + et sa partie a l enver qu'on fait en arrière laisse vraiment penser que le parc veux nous pousser a plus de sensations! Et c est ca qu'on aime. La gare a des jeux de lumière a chaque passage en gare ils sont aller très loin ! Merci le parc. On vois qu'ils veulent satisfaire et c est parti pris🙏❤️

 on a hate que notre petit spirou rentre dans la cour des grands (et dans le sud on compte sur lui vraiment car c est le désert hein🤭🤣). Une belle avancée, reste a faire pareil a petit dans le cœur du parc au fur et a mesure 🥰

En tout cas il y a tellement a dire de cette journée je serais ravie d'échanger avec vous si vous voulez 😍

Si vous êtes dans le coin allez y, le parc est propre, les opé sont si gentils, j'aime tellement les parcs régionaux pour ces échanges avec eux, les attractions sont sympa a faire en famille, ado ou même pour adultes. On voit que le parc est a l'écoute. Les mascottes super sympa aussi. 

Petit point d'amélioration : les ramen au linguini😢 c'est bon mais on veux des nouilles svp🙏❤️ manque un peu d assaisonnement mais 20 euros le menu pour un parc c'est deja super et en plus en raccord avec la zone merci on en a marre des burger partout 😅

Puis bon a chaque fois toujours pas mal de pannes dans le parc, la c est ok pour la reprise mais 5 attractions en pannes en même temps..on avait bien tout fait le matin oufff et avec cette chaleur dommage que le flume etait fermé et le nid du marsu 😉

Bon bref bon petit parc régional et a 1h de chez nous on est tres content 🥰❤️ pour notre 2nd visite on a vu bcp d'amélioration 😍😶

Watching the watchers: emperor cichlids (𝐵𝑜𝑢𝑙𝑒𝑛𝑔𝑒𝑟𝑜𝑐ℎ𝑟𝑜𝑚𝑖𝑠 𝑚𝑖𝑐𝑟𝑜𝑙𝑒𝑝𝑖𝑠), one of the largest cichlid species, can perceive attention towards their offspring by divers. Sensitivity to gaze, or the ability to notice where others are looking, has been widely studied in species such as primates and birds, but has received far less attention in fish. To address this gap, researchers from Japan travelled to Lake Tanganyika in East Africa to investigate how fish respond to being watched.

“These findings suggest that fish may possess a rudimentary form of ‘attention attribution’—the ability to recognize where another individual’s focus lies. Consequently, we may need to account for the role of ‘gaze’ in shaping wildlife responses within ecotourism and conservation contexts.”

正直年齢的にも回復が遅くなってきている中、若い人たちのエネルギーにまだまだ頑張れてます（笑）感謝です🌟

A comunidade otaku entrou em modo nostalgia nesta semana ao relembrar que já se passaram exatos 14 anos desde que o episódio #248 de Naruto Shippuden, intitulado "A Batalha do Yondaime", foi ao ar originalmente no Japão em 9 de fevereiro de 2012. O confronto entre o Quarto Hokage, Minato Namikaze, e o enigmático "Homem Mascarado" (Obito Uchiha) é frequentemente citado como uma das lutas mais bem coreografadas e inteligentes da obra de Masashi Kishimoto, destacando a genialidade tática do Flash Amarelo de Konoha.

O momento ápice da luta, onde Minato utiliza o Hiraishin (Deus Voador do Trovão) de Nível 2 para superar a intangibilidade do Kamui e atingir o oponente com um Rasengan devastador, continua sendo um dos frames mais icônicos da animação japonesa. Além do espetáculo visual, a batalha carrega um peso dramático imenso, ocorrendo durante o ataque da Raposa de Nove Caudas à Vila da Folha e culminando no sacrifício heroico de Minato e Kushina para proteger seu filho recém-nascido, Naruto Uzumaki. Mesmo após mais de uma década, a precisão e a velocidade de Minato nesta luta ainda servem de referência para o que define um combate de alto nível no mundo shinobi.

À partir d’une histoire vraie, #Julian déploie un récit fragmenté, intime et profondément politique, où la mémoire se reconstruit par éclats. Refusant toute linéarité comme tout didactisme, la réalisatrice Cato Kusters choisit de faire de l’amour — dans sa forme la plus concrète, la plus incarnée — le cœur battant de son film. Entre fidélité au réel et liberté de mise en scène, elle revient sur la genèse de ce projet, son travail d’adaptation et la manière dont le cinéma peut, encore aujourd’hui, devenir un geste d’espoir.

Un episodio épico y doloroso...

Hace 17 años, un día como hoy, Minato se enfrentó a su jóven discipulo Obito, un combate HISTÓRICO🔥

📅 9 de febrero (Japón)
⚡Naruto Shippuden EP: "¡El Cuarto Hokage!" (四代目の死闘!)

Este episodio quedó grabado en la historia del anime por mostrarnos uno de los enfrentamientos más impactantes de la serie: maestro contra alumno. Minato Namikaze, el Cuarto Hokage, demostró con frialdad, inteligencia y velocidad por qué era considerado una leyenda viva. 🌀💥

Mientras Kushina daba a luz al pequeño Naruto, la tragedia golpeó Konoha. Obito apareció desde las sombras, liberó a Kurama y sumió a la aldea en el caos. En medio del ataque del Nueve Colas, Minato se enfrentó directamente a su antiguo alumno en un duelo relámpago, logrando marcarlo con el Hiraishin y romper su control sobre el Bijū mediante el Sello del Contrato. 🔥🦊

Un episodio que no solo fue espectacular en acción, sino clave para entender el sacrificio de Minato, el origen del sufrimiento de Naruto y las consecuencias que definirían toda la historia posterior. Un momento eterno del anime.

Poco se habla de la edad que tenía Obito cuando hizo eso...

اخخخ على وش عاشو كاكاشي💔أفضل شخصية بدون منازع💔🫩كاكاشي هاتاكي هو أحد أعمدة عالم ناروتو وأكثر الشخصيات عمقًا وتأثيرًا فيه. وُلد في قرية كونوها وهو ابن النينجا الأسطوري ساكومو هاتاكي المعروف بـ“الناب الأبيض”، ما وضع عليه ضغطًا هائلًا منذ صغره ليكون عبقريًا مثل والده. التحق بالأكاديمية في سن مبكرة وتخرّج بسرعة لافتة، ثم أصبح جونين في عمر صغير جدًا. خلال الحرب العظمى الثالثة كان ضمن فريق يقوده ميناتو ناميكازي رفقة أوبيتو أوتشيها ورين نوهارا، وهناك تغيّرت حياته بالكامل؛ إذ أهداه أوبيتو عين الشارينغان قبل أن يُعتقد أنه مات، ولاحقًا اضطر كاكاشي لقتل رين بيده دون أن يعلم أنها فضّلت الموت لمنع العدو من استغلالها، فترسّخ داخله شعور الذنب والحزن الذي رافقه لسنوات. عُرف بلقب “النينجا الناسخ” لأنه نسخ أكثر من ألف تقنية بفضل الشارينغان، وأصبح من أمهر مستخدمي البرق بابتكاره تقنية الرايكيري (التشيدوري المطوّر). رغم مظهره الهادئ وكسله الظاهري وحبّه لقراءة الروايات، فهو شديد الذكاء، بارع في التحليل، ويمتلك حسًا قياديًا وإنسانيًا عاليًا، ويتّضح ذلك عندما تولّى تدريب الفريق السابع: ناروتو أوزوماكي، ساسكي أوتشيها، وساكورا هارونو، حيث علّمهم معنى العمل الجماعي وكسَر فيهم الأنانية. مع مرور الأحداث شارك في أهم المعارك ضد الأكاتسوكي والحروب الكبرى، وكُشف أن أوبيتو ما زال حيًا وأنه كان وراء كثير من المآسي، ما صدم كاكاشي نفسيًا لكنه واجهه بشجاعة. في الحرب العظمى الرابعة أظهر قدرات مذهلة باستخدام المانغيكيو شارينغان وتقنية الكاموي، ولعب دورًا حاسمًا في إنقاذ العالم إلى جانب ناروتو وساسكي. بعد الحرب، وبسبب حكمته وخبرته وثقة الجميع به، أصبح الهوكاجي السادس لكونوها، وقاد القرية بفترة استقرار وسلام. شخصية كاكاشي تمزج بين العبقرية القتالية، الألم النفسي، الحس الإنساني، وروح المعلّم، لذلك يُعتبر من أكثر الشخصيات المحبوبة والمأثرة في السلسلة 🫶🏻🥹💔#kakashi #anime #sedsong #fypppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppp #viralvideo_foryoupage

​While waiting for the chain and sprocket set to arrive, I decided to pull the cover for a thorough inspection of the speed sensor, clutch slave cylinder, and push rod.

​After everything else I've found on this build, I shouldn't be surprised—but the neglect under this cover was no different from the rest of the bike. A heavy buildup of grease, sand, road grit, and debris had completely overtaken the housing.

​Every component has now been meticulously cleaned, inspected, and torqued to spec. I’ll be back under this cover one last time once the new drivetrain arrives. The countdown to the first ride is on! ⛓️

EL PARQUE TEMÁTICO DE NARUTO EN JAPÓN AHORA OFRECE UNA VERSIÓN REAL DEL ARMA NINJA DEL CUARTO HOKAGE

Ubicado en la isla de Awajishima en la prefectura de Hyogo, #NijigennoMori acaba de empezar a ofrecer una entrada premium especial que, junto con la entrada al parque, te otorga uno de los #kunai que empuño #MinatoNamikaze (#CuartoHokage), padre de #Naruto y el abuelo de #Boruto.

A diferencia de un kunai estándar de una sola hoja, los Kunai del Dios del Trueno Volador son como pequeños tridentes arrojadizos, y la recreación del mundo real que ofrece Nijigen no Mori tiene los mismos #kanji escritos en su empuñadura que la versión de anime/manga.

Nijigen no Mori no menciona el material utilizado, pero dado que las entradas para la #AldeaNinja de Naruto y Boruto tienen un precio inicial de 3300 yenes ($21 dólares) y que la Entrada Premium de la Aldea Ninja con el Kunai de #Minato cuesta 50 000 yenes (aprox. $325 dólares), parece casi seguro que el kunai es una pieza metálica real, no de plástico, y que la caja en la que viene también es de madera auténtica. Sin embargo, dados los problemas legales causados ​​por la Espada de Gryffindor de Harry Potter en #Japón, es seguro asumir que los bordes y las puntas del kunai están desafilados.

Savaşın Sessiz Tanıkları: Patlamaların Gölgesinde Üç Küçük Dost
 Bir beton damın kenarında, yan yana dizilmiş üç kedi... Biri gri, biri alacalı, diğeri kömür karası. Arka planda yükselen devasa duman kütlelerini, patlama seslerini ve yıkılan binaları büyük bir metanetle —belki de büyük bir çaresizlikle— izliyorlar.
 Bu kareler, savaşın acımasız yüzünü en yalın haliyle gösteriyor. İnsanoğlunun bitmek bilmeyen hırsları ve yıkım gücü, gökyüzünü siyah dumanlarla kaplarken, bu masum canlılar sessizce tanıklık ediyor. Onlar için bu dumanlar bir "jeopolitik kriz" değil; bozulan huzurları, yok olan yuvaları ve kesilen güvenli uykuları anlamına geliyor.
Savaş haberlerinde genellikle rakamlar ve haritalar konuşulur. Ancak bu kareler, madalyonun diğer yüzünü hatırlatıyor: Doğal yaşamın yıkımı, içgüdüsel bir dayanışma ve anlamsızlığın izleyicileri... İnsanların neden kendi yaşam alanlarını yok ettiğini anlaması imkansız olan bu canlılar, dumanların içinden tanıdık bir ses veya bir mama kokusu bekliyor olabilir.
 Gökyüzü karardıkça ve patlamalar yaklaştıkça, bu masum tanıkların kaçacak bir yerleri kalmıyor. Bu görüntüler, savaşın sadece insanları değil, dünyayı paylaştığımız tüm dostlarımızı da aynı karanlık çukura sürüklediğinin en yalın kanıtı olarak tarihe geçiyor.

 Sizce bu kedilerin şu an nerede olduğu, güvende olup olmadıkları bilinmiyor. Onlar sadece savaşın mağdur ettiği milyonlarca canlıdan biri. Bu görüntüler hakkında ne düşünüyorsunuz? Yorumlarda paylaşın.

My painting, “Your Shoulder, My Sorrow,” was inspired by the legendary Persian song “Shanehayat” a masterpiece performed by Hayedeh, composed by Farid Zoland, and written by Ardalan Sarfaraz. The central pillar of this work is the iconic line, “Shanehayat ra baraye gerye kardan doost daram,” which translates to “I love your shoulders for crying on.” It depicts the singer seeking refuge from the “cruelties of the world” (namardomiha), finding the strength to endure life’s injustices by leaning into the kindness of another.  Bringing this piece to life was a turbulent process. I walked away and came back to the canvas countless times, with the fear that I had pushed the layers too far and ruined it forever. Yet, through that anxiety and cycle of breaking and mending, that the painting finally found its way.

There are faces that arrive already annotated by history — titles, fortunes, scandals carefully attached. And then there are faces like Edward Vickers. Painted around 1884 by John Singer Sargent, at that precise moment when youth still believes it will become something definite, Vickers offers us very little. No narrative, no triumph — only a gaze suspended between self-awareness and expectation. He is, of course, handsome. The kind of beauty Sargent returned to with noticeable consistency — not quite power, but promise, arranged with care. The red background does the rest. Not passion, but a studied intensity, as if significance could be composed like décor. History, of course, was not convinced. And so he remains: perfectly composed, faintly expectant — and already, one suspects, slightly obsolete.
.
.
Há rostos que chegam já anotados pela história — títulos, fortunas, escândalos cuidadosamente colados. E depois há rostos como o de Edward Vickers. Pintado por volta de 1884 por John Singer Sargent, nesse preciso momento em que a juventude ainda acredita que se tornará algo de definido, Vickers oferece-nos muito pouco. Nenhuma narrativa, nenhum triunfo — apenas um olhar suspenso entre a consciência de si e a expectativa. É, naturalmente, bonito. Um tipo de beleza ao qual Sargent regressava com uma consistência reveladora — não propriamente poder, mas promessa, cuidadosamente composta. O fundo vermelho faz o resto. Não paixão, mas uma intensidade estudada, como se a importância pudesse ser arranjada como decoração. A história, claro, não se deixou convencer. E assim permanece: perfeitamente composto, vagamente expectante — e já, suspeita-se, ligeiramente ultrapassado.
.
.
.

.

Mostly tried to keep original colours from shippuden, might redesign her, genin, before the war, the last outfit and and boruto outfit

Her hair is my favorite in the anime, but I wish she grew it out more, like her hair after the war arc.

I wanted to put her haruno crest in the front so it stands out more.

Since she is also a medic I would assume she would have a bandage covering her arm, since she would get bruises, cuts and training as she would have alot of them. 

 I also put her headband around her hips, I would assume before she goes on missions she would put it on her head, but she would keep it around her waste.

(Her bandage is not red. My line to the word red is actually for her shirt😅, and i wanted baige for her skirt, but pink stood out to me)

اخخخ على وش عاشو كاكاشي💔أفضل شخصية بدون منازع💔🫩كاكاشي هاتاكي هو أحد أعمدة عالم ناروتو وأكثر الشخصيات عمقًا وتأثيرًا فيه. وُلد في قرية كونوها وهو ابن النينجا الأسطوري ساكومو هاتاكي المعروف بـ“الناب الأبيض”، ما وضع عليه ضغطًا هائلًا منذ صغره ليكون عبقريًا مثل والده. التحق بالأكاديمية في سن مبكرة وتخرّج بسرعة لافتة، ثم أصبح جونين في عمر صغير جدًا. خلال الحرب العظمى الثالثة كان ضمن فريق يقوده ميناتو ناميكازي رفقة أوبيتو أوتشيها ورين نوهارا، وهناك تغيّرت حياته بالكامل؛ إذ أهداه أوبيتو عين الشارينغان قبل أن يُعتقد أنه مات، ولاحقًا اضطر كاكاشي لقتل رين بيده دون أن يعلم أنها فضّلت الموت لمنع العدو من استغلالها، فترسّخ داخله شعور الذنب والحزن الذي رافقه لسنوات. عُرف بلقب “النينجا الناسخ” لأنه نسخ أكثر من ألف تقنية بفضل الشارينغان، وأصبح من أمهر مستخدمي البرق بابتكاره تقنية الرايكيري (التشيدوري المطوّر). رغم مظهره الهادئ وكسله الظاهري وحبّه لقراءة الروايات، فهو شديد الذكاء، بارع في التحليل، ويمتلك حسًا قياديًا وإنسانيًا عاليًا، ويتّضح ذلك عندما تولّى تدريب الفريق السابع: ناروتو أوزوماكي، ساسكي أوتشيها، وساكورا هارونو، حيث علّمهم معنى العمل الجماعي وكسَر فيهم الأنانية. مع مرور الأحداث شارك في أهم المعارك ضد الأكاتسوكي والحروب الكبرى، وكُشف أن أوبيتو ما زال حيًا وأنه كان وراء كثير من المآسي، ما صدم كاكاشي نفسيًا لكنه واجهه بشجاعة. في الحرب العظمى الرابعة أظهر قدرات مذهلة باستخدام المانغيكيو شارينغان وتقنية الكاموي، ولعب دورًا حاسمًا في إنقاذ العالم إلى جانب ناروتو وساسكي. بعد الحرب، وبسبب حكمته وخبرته وثقة الجميع به، أصبح الهوكاجي السادس لكونوها، وقاد القرية بفترة استقرار وسلام. شخصية كاكاشي تمزج بين العبقرية القتالية، الألم النفسي، الحس الإنساني، وروح المعلّم، لذلك يُعتبر من أكثر الشخصيات المحبوبة والمأثرة في السلسلة 🫶🏻🥹💔#kakashi #anime #sedsong #fypppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppppp #viralvideo_foryoupage

Vo svete Naruta sa síce pozornosť sústreďuje najmä na súboje a priateľstvá, no objavujú sa aj silné romantické príbehy. Medzi nimi vyniká tragický vzťah medzi Itachim Uchihom a Izumi, ktorý mnohí fanúšikovia ani nepoznajú. Ich puto začalo nenápadne počas školských čias, keď si Izumi obľúbila tichého a talentovaného chlapca. Postupne sa zblížili, hoci Itachi si svoje emócie nechával často pre seba.

S pribúdajúcimi povinnosťami a rastúcim napätím v klane Uchiha sa ich stretnutia stávali čoraz vzácnejšími. Situácia vyústila do tragédie počas masakru klanu, keď Itachi dostal úlohu zabrániť vojne za každú cenu. Izumi sa stala jeho prvou obeťou, no zároveň aj osobou, ktorej chcel dopriať pokojný koniec.

Pred sm*ťou jej pomocou schopnosti Mangekyo Sharingan daroval ilúziu spoločného života. V nej prežili roky ako partneri, založili rodinu a dožili sa staroby. Pre Izumi tak vznikol sen naplnený láskou, zatiaľ čo realita priniesla krátky, no o to silnejší moment rozlúčky.

Anime verzia tento príbeh zmenila a jej sm*ť pripísala inej postave, čím pripravila fanúšikov o jednu z najemotívnejších scén. Napriek tomu zostáva Itachiho príbeh stále symbolom obety, bolesti a nenaplnenej lásky.

Um juiz de Colatina determinou que a ferrovia da Vale seja liberada em todo o Espírito Santo após manifestantes bloquearem os trilhos. A decisão considerou que o bloqueio é ilegal e prejudica um serviço público essencial, afetando tanto o transporte de passageiros quanto de cargas importantes para o país.

A ordem vale para toda a ferrovia no estado, porque os manifestantes estavam mudando os locais de bloqueio para dificultar a ação da Justiça.

O juiz deu prazo de até 30 minutos para desocupação, com multa de R$ 10 mil por pessoa que permanecer no local e R$ 50 mil por novos bloqueios. Também autorizou o uso da polícia e até prisão em caso de descumprimento.

Além disso, a decisão se baseia em uma nova lei que considera crime grave interromper serviços essenciais, com penas que podem chegar a 40 anos de prisão.

Neji left town for his cousin during the May holidays and did not respond to his graduate student’s messages - he has the right. Yes, and he need to write master’s degree.

Gaara then showed up at his place (thanks to the rector for giving the son of the university’s main patron the address of Neji), and Hinata, out of the kindness of her heart, kept Gaara as her guest.

Neji tried to prevent this, and then to talk again in private, but the compassionate girl saw in the boy’s freaky appearance a cry for help, and in no way agreed to send him away.

Then Neji tried to talk to Gaara, too, to get the hell out of there. But it’s kind of hard for the guy to concentrate when the door to Neji’s room closes and they’re left alone.

🌴Some staycations tick the boxes. This one coloured it in, added the glitter you hide at the back of the drawer, and kept the kids busy all weekend. A really wonderful balance of relaxation and adventure.🌴

@lapitahoteldubai was the spot, a five star Polynesian-inspired resort surrounded by lush tropical gardens, and the updated interiors give the whole place a fresh, modern feel without losing its charm.

For kids, it’s paradise. Swimming pools, a lazy river, mini splash park, football and volleyball on the grass, life-size Snakes & Ladders, foosball, and LOTS of space to explore. Indoors, there’s a wonderful kids’ club and the Tiki House craft room for creative downtime.

The restaurants are thoughtfully designed for families, and Kahuna’s Italian restaurant has just launched a new menu, with live music on Friday and Saturday nights, perfect for settling into the holiday vibes.

If staying over on a Saturday, the LuWow brunch at Kalea is definitely worth doing. Plenty of interactive activities for the kids, which means everyone gets to enjoy themselves. What a concept!

The theme parks are a very manageable 10 minute walk, which is wildly convenient. We gave Motiongate a confident one hour attempt, quickly realised we’d overestimated our little audience, and wandered back to the pool. But the ease of it all was a big win!

This genuinely felt like an easy holiday for us, and I don’t say this lightly as a (young) family of five. We’ll be back!

It’s only natural to say that, fighting side by side, these three make an impressive trio, but even more impressive than that is the bond they share. Despite being so different, their dynamic is built on a deep sense of unity that never once wavers.

👾 Sara (INTJ) is the brain of the team, easily the most talented of the three. While ninjutsu is her greatest strength, sarcasm is her favorite defense. Her brilliance sets her apart, but it’s her overwhelming sense of responsibility to protect Renji and Nao that truly makes her formidable.

🌀 Renji (INFJ), the embodiment of Hyūga talent and resilience, is the anchor that brings balance to the team. Calm, rational, and quietly strong, he stands between Nao’s impulsiveness and Sara’s restraint, a steady presence with a genuinely pure heart.

🐵 Nao (ENFP) is, without a doubt, the heart of Team 11. Expressive, emotional, loud, impulsive, and fearless, the young Sarutobi kunoichi is the team’s energy. She constantly challenges Sara’s distance and Renji’s composure, bringing warmth and chaos in equal measure, and reminding them that they’re more than just shinobi, they’re a family.

(⛧post 1 of 4⛧)

Hail, seekers. 🙏 Let us turn our will toward ⛧⛧Duke Gusion⛧⛧, the 11th spirit of the ⛧Ars Goetia⛧, a strong Duke commanding forty legions. He appears as a Xenophilus or Cynocephalus—a noble, baboon-headed figure—and is a profound ally for truth, reconciliation, and honor.

His domain is ⛧⛧Mercury⛧⛧ and ⛧⛧Air⛧⛧ 🪐, governing intellect, communication, and hidden knowledge. To align with his current, work on ⛧⛧Wednesdays⛧⛧, during Mercury's planetary hour, or under the Gemini sun. His sacred metal is ⛧⛧quicksilver⛧⛧ (handle with extreme care!), and his colors are blue, yellow, and violet.

His traditional enn, or summoning chant, is: ⛧⛧"Secora Vesa Anet Gusion."⛧⛧

Below are the sacred implements for his rites:
⛧ ⛧⛧Sigil & Mirror⛧⛧: His seal and a black scrying mirror for vision.
⛧ ⛧⛧Air & Mercury Tools⛧⛧: A wand, bell, frankincense or sandalwood incense, and yellow/blue candles.
⛧ ⛧⛧Offerings⛧⛧: Wine, clear quartz, or scribal tools (quill, parchment).

Demon of the week: Duke Gusion 🔥

Gusion is the eleventh spirit of the Ars Goetia governing forty legions of spirits. He is a very versatile spirit to work with but demands sincerity from the practitioner. The Pseudomonarchia Daemonum refers to Gusion as a xenophilius, meaning “one who loves the strange” or “foreign friend” in Greek. This could also be a play on the Greek word “Cynocephalus” meaning “dog-headed” which relates to this demon's typical appearance.

Sadly, there is very little traceable history on Gusion outside of the Ars Goetia. Some sources suggest he was discovered by necromancers in the Renaissance period, but evidence is lacking to confirm this.

Sadly, there is very little traceable history on Gusion outside of the Ars Goetia. Some sources suggest he was discovered by necromancers in the Renaissance period, but evidence is lacking to confirm this.

The Youngest Kazekage

Gaara is the Fifth Kazekage (Godaime Kazekage) of Sunagakure, the Hidden Sand Village. Once a feared and ruthless antagonist, he underwent a profound transformation after his battle with Naruto Uzumaki, eventually becoming one of the youngest and most respected leaders in the shinobi world.

Inspired by Naruto’s empathy, Gaara sought the title not for power, but to protect his people and earn their genuine respect, effectively dispelling the fear caused by his status as a former Jinchūriki.

Military Commander: 
During the Fourth Shinobi World War, he served as the Regimental Commander of the Allied Shinobi Forces and the leader of the Fourth Division, proving his tactical brilliance and ability to unite different nations. 

Ultimate Defense: 
A constant "Shield of Sand" automatically protects him from physical harm, a power originally attributed to the One-Tailed Shukaku but later revealed to be fueled by his mother's love.

Sand Manipulation: 
His signature techniques include the Sand Coffin (Sabaku Kyū) and Sand Burial (Sabaku Sōsō), along with large-scale moves like the Sand Tsunami (Ryūryū Sabakuryū).

Sand Gourd: 
He carries a gourd made of sand on his back, containing chakra-infused sand that he can control more quickly than the surrounding environment.

Reasonings for each Pokemon will be listed below:

1. Mega Lucario can sense and manipulate Aura much like a Chakra, as well as its heightened aura mastery mirrors Naruto's Sage Mode and Kurama chakra cloak.

2. Ninetales directly represents the Nine Tails Kurama that Naruto has sealed.

3. Greninja is the literal ninja pokemon, representing Naruto's usage of kunai and shurikens, while also having speed and agility.

4. Tornadus represents Naruto's Wind Release transformation, as well as his tornado abilities

5. Hisuian Zoroark represents Naruto's illusion and transformation abilities, while also being another nod to Kurama due to being a fox.

6. While the weakest of the examples, Hitmonlee represents how Naruto's Taijutsu technique is heavily kick based, as are Hitmonlee's attacks.

O processo:
1. Triagem de ~400 ativos para os 50 melhores
2. Debate adversário (Bull vs Bear) para cada ação
3. Modelagem de 3 cenários com preços-alvo
4. Construção final com regras rígidas de alocação

O resultado: uma carteira com retorno esperado de 16.4% em 12 meses — contra ~11% do Ibovespa.

Destaques:
- EMBJ3 (Embraer) é a maior posição: 12%. Backlog de US$ 31.6 bilhões e desconto brutal vs peers globais.
- SMFT3 (Smart Fit) tem o maior retorno esperado: 26%. Lucro cresceu 40% em 2025.
- PRIO3 entrou no lugar de PETR4. Sem risco político, com petróleo acima de US$ 100.

E sim — PETR4 e VALE3 ficaram de fora. Deslize para entender por quê.

A carteira completa, as teses e os riscos estão nos slides. Salva esse post para consultar.

Toda semana a IA roda de novo e publica aqui o resultado. Siga para acompanhar.

🗓️ A partir de janeiro de 2026, o vale-alimentação dos servidores federais passará de R$ 658 para R$ 1.192. A portaria que oficializa o reajuste foi publicada nesta quinta-feira (25) pelo Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação em Serviços Públicos.

🤝 A medida é resultado das negociações da Mesa Nacional de Negociação Permanente com o Governo Federal. Para compensar a diferença até 2026, os servidores receberão um "vale-pedágio" em maio, conforme comunicado pela Federação Nacional dos Trabalhadores do Judiciário Federal e Ministério Público da União (Fenajufe).

📊 O acordo também prevê reajuste de 4,5% nos salários em 2025 e 4,5% em 2026, com impacto orçamentário total de R$ 32 bilhões ao longo dos próximos três anos. Os benefícios, como o auxílio-saúde e o auxílio-creche, também serão majorados.

💰 O vale-alimentação, que atualmente está defasado em relação ao setor privado, terá um aumento considerável, aproximando-se da média do mercado. O reajuste visa melhorar as condições de trabalho e a valorização dos servidores públicos.

It’s only natural to say that, fighting side by side, these three make an impressive trio, but even more impressive than that is the bond they share. Despite being so different, their dynamic is built on a deep sense of unity that never once wavers.

👾 Sara is the brain of the team, easily the most talented of the three. While ninjutsu is her greatest strength, sarcasm is her favorite defense. Her brilliance sets her apart, but it’s her overwhelming sense of responsibility to protect Renji and Nao that truly makes her formidable.

🌀 Renji, the embodiment of Hyūga talent and resilience, is the anchor that brings balance to the team. Calm, rational, and quietly strong, he stands between Nao’s impulsiveness and Sara’s restraint, a steady presence with a genuinely pure heart.

🐵 Nao is, without a doubt, the heart of Team 11. Expressive, emotional, loud, impulsive, and fearless, the young Sarutobi kunoichi is the team’s energy. She constantly challenges Sara’s distance and Renji’s composure, bringing warmth and chaos in equal measure, and reminding them that they’re more than just shinobi, they’re a family.

1.	Lahir dari Keluarga Bangsawan Paxley
Gusion terlahir di House Paxley, keluarga bangsawan mage paling berpengaruh di Land of Dawn. Sejak kecil ia dididik untuk menjadi penyihir elit dengan sihir tradisional keluarga.
	2.	Pemberontakan terhadap Tradisi Keluarga
Berbeda dari anggota Paxley lainnya, Gusion menolak penggunaan tongkat sihir. Ia memilih belati sihir, yang dianggap tidak pantas dan memalukan oleh keluarganya.
	3.	Dianggap Pengkhianat oleh House Paxley
Karena menentang aturan, Gusion dicap sebagai pemberontak dan diasingkan. Ia memilih meninggalkan rumah demi mengikuti jalannya sendiri.
	4.	Pertarungan dengan Aamon
Dalam perjalanannya, Gusion berhadapan dengan Aamon, saudara sekaligus eksekutor House Paxley. Pertarungan mereka mencerminkan konflik antara kewajiban keluarga dan kebebasan pribadi.
	5.	Menemukan Jati Diri sebagai Assassin Mage
Setelah meninggalkan Paxley, Gusion mengasah gaya bertarung uniknya dan membuktikan bahwa belati sihir bisa melampaui sihir tradisional, menjadikannya assassin mage paling mematikan di Land of Dawn.

Uma IA analisou 400 ativos da B3 e montou uma carteira de 15 ações para bater o Ibovespa.

Sem opinião humana. Sem achismo. Só dados.

O processo:
1. Triagem de ~400 ativos para os 50 melhores
2. Debate adversário (Bull vs Bear) para cada ação
3. Modelagem de 3 cenários com preços-alvo
4. Construção final com regras rígidas de alocação

O resultado: uma carteira com retorno esperado de 16.4% em 12 meses — contra ~11% do Ibovespa.

Destaques:
- EMBJ3 (Embraer) é a maior posição: 12%. Backlog de US$ 31.6 bilhões e desconto brutal vs peers globais.
- SMFT3 (Smart Fit) tem o maior retorno esperado: 26%. Lucro cresceu 40% em 2025.
- PRIO3 entrou no lugar de PETR4. Sem risco político, com petróleo acima de US$ 100.

E sim — PETR4 e VALE3 ficaram de fora. Deslize para entender por quê.

A carteira completa, as teses e os riscos estão nos slides. Salva esse post para consultar.

Toda semana a IA roda de novo e publica aqui o resultado. Siga para acompanhar.

Fakta mengenai hobi Gaara ini tidak diperlihatkan dalam serial anime atau manga utama Naruto yang sangat populer, melainkan diungkapkan dalam light novel resmi pasca-Perang Dunia Shinobi Keempat, yaitu Gaara Hiden: A Sandstorm Mirage.

Dalam novel tersebut, di tengah hiruk pikuk tanggung jawabnya sebagai Kazekage, hobi Gaara menanam kaktus terungkap. Ini sangat sesuai dengan karakternya dan lingkungan Desa Sunagakure yang kering. Kaktus adalah tanaman yang sangat tangguh, membutuhkan sedikit air, dan mampu bertahan di lingkungan gurun yang keras, mirip dengan ketangguhan Gaara sendiri.

Hobi ini menunjukkan sisi Gaara yang damai dan reflektif, jauh dari citra pembunuh tanpa emosi yang ia tunjukkan di awal serial. Hal ini melambangkan karakternya yang telah tumbuh dan menemukan ketenangan.

The Kazekages are the leaders of Sunagakure (the Hidden Sand Village) in the Naruto series. Here are the first five Kazekages: 

First Kazekage (Reto): Founded Sunagakure by gathering desert-dwelling shinobi using his overwhelming power. He was present at the first-ever Five Kage Summit.

Second Kazekage (Shamon): The first to research the Jinchūriki (specifically Shukaku, the One-Tail) to enhance the village's power. He also founded the Puppet Brigade.

Third Kazekage: Widely considered the most powerful Kazekage in history, he developed a unique Magnet Release to control Iron Sand. He was famously kidnapped and murdered by Sasori, who turned him into a human puppet.

Fourth Kazekage (Rasa): Utilized Magnet Release to control Gold Dust to combat the One-Tailed Shukaku's rampages. He is the father of Gaara, Temari, and Kankurō.

Fifth Kazekage (Gaara): Initially the Jinchūriki of the One-Tail, he later became a leader known for his supreme manipulation of sand for offense and defense (Shield of Sand).

Eu sei que esse caminho pode ser solitário e doloroso, principalmente quando a pressão de estar sempre sendo melhor nunca dá trégua. Em algum momento, você aprendeu que ser forte era a única alternativa, e que ser vulnerável era sinônimo de fraqueza. Mas não é!!!!!

Você não precisa sustentar tudo o tempo inteiro. Existe espaço para baixar a guarda, para não dar conta, para ser acolhido. Ser “fraco”, também é uma forma de cuidado, e talvez seja exatamente isso que esteja te faltando agora.

MADARA 👹

Técnica: lápis de cor em folha canson A5. 
_
Primeira arte feita da enquete dos stories. 
_
Fiz algo não convencional ao anime Naruto, pois pelo meu entendimento, desenhar um personagem de anime é algo um pouco mais tranquilo do que o restante das artes que já fiz. Então, decidi sair um pouco da zona de conforto e tentei buscar algo mais realista para o personagem, algo trazido para o realismo colorido que é minha técnica favorita. Algo que impactasse mais os olhos de quem ver esta arte. Algo não tão sombrio, mas algo que destacasse a sede do antagonista.

Essas artes sugeridas por enquete, eu sempre estarei fazendo em folhas menores, como A5, pois como tbm trabalho através de encomendas, essas pequenas artes fica como uma amostra para quem se interessar em encomendar algo com o mesmo personagem ou do mesmo contexto e aí sim, uma arte será feita em folhas maiores.

Deixe seu comentário pra gente saber o que vc achou desta arte e se possível, deixe seu ❤️, se vc gostou.

🔥OBSESSION🔥

Obsession ist kein stilles Gefühl.
Es ist kein leises Sehnen, das man in den Schatten verstecken könnte.
Es ist ein Sturm, der mit jeder Sekunde stärker wird –
ein Feuer, das man nicht kontrollieren kann.

Es frisst, was schwach ist.
Es verzehrt, was stark ist.
Und manchmal bleibt nur ein Schatten von dem, was wir einst waren.

Für Kalea bedeutet Obsession mehr als bloße Begierde.
Es ist das unkontrollierbare Drängen, das ihr Herz schneller schlagen lässt,
der brennende Blick, der sie verfolgt – selbst wenn sie die Augen schließt.
Obsession verwischt die Grenzen zwischen Angst und Verlangen,
zwischen Hingabe und Selbstzerstörung.

Es ist ein Feuer, das nicht wärmt, sondern verbrennt.
Und doch… sie sucht es immer wieder.
Weil in dieser Dunkelheit eine Wahrheit liegt, die heller strahlt als jedes Licht:
Dass wir manchmal in unserer Besessenheit lebendiger sind als in all der Ruhe, die wir so sehr fürchten. 🌑

#Kalea #DarkRomance #Obsession #BookTeaser #psychologicaltrauma #darkness #darksouls

《望遠凝視》
數位攝影、UV輸出透明幻燈片
2022、2025

計劃衍生自《島嶼輪廓》。在《望遠凝視》中，我與另一位攝影師在世界的兩個端點，持相機，用一樣的焦段與片幅，將取景框中央瞄準對方的座標位置，於同日同時同分同秒按下相機快門。以此方法拍攝的組合照照片，是為透過兩張焦平面面貌組合而成的一組視線的成像，如同一條被前後壓縮的吐司，將理論距離萬分遙遠的視線一次呈現在觀眾眼前。

“Telescopic Gaze”
Digital photography, UV print on transparent film
2022、2025

This project developed from The Contour of the Island. Another photographer and I stood at two distant points in the world, each holding a camera with the same focal length and frame format. We aimed the center of our viewfinders at each other’s coordinates and pressed the shutter at the exact same moment.

The resulting paired images form a composite line of sight through the combination of two focal planes. Like a slice of bread compressed from both ends, the theoretically immense distance of a gaze is condensed and presented to the viewer at once.

I blinked awake to find myself perched beside another goose who had just woken up too, both staring upward with wide-eyed wonder 😊. We weren’t sure what was calling us—maybe stars above or secrets hidden beneath our soft down 🌌. My neck stretched tall while theirs curved gently, like we were answering some silent summons from the clouds ☁️. “What’s so magical?” whispered my companion with a half-smile, tilting his head curiously 🤔. Suddenly, a breeze carried laughter through the air—we’d forgotten how much joy there is in simply being together 🥰. Then came a tiny chime from beyond the horizon—a melody only we could hear 🎵. As dusk painted the world violet around us, we felt peace settle into every feather ✨. Our wings didn't need to fly today; hearts soared higher than ever before 💖. Side-by-side under endless twilight skies, we vowed never to lose each other again 👫. And when night finally fell, we snuggled close... ready for tomorrow's magic to unfold once more 🦢🌙.

Non potevo non disegnare lui.
Lui è il mio personaggio preferito di "Naruto": Sasuke✏️💙

Tante persone lo giudicano e lo criticano molto a causa delle scelte che ha preso nel corso dell'anime, tante altre persone invece lo amano e lo comprendono.

È un ragazzo misterioso, soprattutto all'inizio della serie. Solitario, difficile, confuso, all'apparenza tranquillo e silenzioso ma dentro non lo è. Dentro di sé ha un tornado di emozioni che però, la maggior parte delle volte, tiene tutte per lui.
Un passato orribile, già da bambino iniziò a provare odio, rancore, rabbia (a causa di un episodio traumatico che si è portato dietro per sempre), sentimenti che l'hanno guidato durante tutta la sua vita finché non ha conosciuto l'amicizia e per un po' il suo cuore si è illuminato, si è aperto, ma l'oscurità prese di nuovo il sopravvento...
Da quel momento se ne andò per la sua strada, per poter raggiungere l'unico obiettivo della sua vita: la vendetta.
Lasciò tutto, la sua casa, i suoi amici, i compagni, i maestri, tutto per poter diventare più forte e potersi finalmente vendicare. Ha messo da parte tutti gli affetti, perché altrimenti  non gli avrebbero permesso di poter realizzare il suo sogno, già, tutte quelle emozioni positive lo avrebbero ostacolato.
Alla fine poi, dopo alti e bassi, battaglie contro sé stesso e contro tutti, è riuscito a ritrovarsi davvero, a ritrovare la pace, ad essere l'amico che avrebbe sempre voluto essere e ad avere gli amici che avrebbe sempre voluto avere. 
Per me, questo è Sasuke.

Per quanto riguarda il suo lato solitario, il lato più tranquillo esilenzioso, e il lato riservato mi ci rivedo molto e penso che vada bene così, non tutti manifestiamo le nostre emozioni allo stesso modo ma non per questo significa che qualcuno sia sbagliato. Non tutti siamo uguali.

Dovrei scrivere mooolto di più ed essere più specifica su alcuni punti, ma è complicato farlo in un post di Instagram ahahah, quindi basta, ho rotto le palle abbastanza😂😊 (non sono una scrittrice e non sono nemmeno troppo brava con le parole ma spero di essere stata comprensibile e soprattutto di aver scritto in italiano😅).

El parque temático Parc Spirou Provence, situado en Monteux, Francia, presenta su nuevo espacio dedicado a Naruto, representando la aldea de Konoha.

El parque ha reabierto sus puertas con la inauguración de Konoha Land, un espacio centrado en recrear Konoha. Este proyecto fue planteado en 2022, por lo que han sido necesarios 4 años de desarrollo y una inversión de 16 millones de euros.

Este nuevo espacio cuenta con dos atracciones, entre ellas una montaña rusa inspirada en el Kyubi, además de zonas decoradas con shurikens y kunais, y un área ambientada como el mítico puesto de ramen Ichiraku. Todo ello acompañado de escenarios icónicos como la montaña de los Hokage y estatuas de personajes como Naruto o Jiraiya.

Completely done. Deeply intentional. Ready for whatever comes next. Some mountain homes ask you to see the potential. This one hands it to you finished. Tucked into a private, wooded lot in Julian, here is a cabin with a clear point of view: moody, considered, and completely at ease in the trees. A cowboy pool for summer afternoons. Come up for an afternoon. You’ll know within the hour.

🍃⚔️ Para quem cresceu admirando os ninjas mais marcantes dos animes, essa peça é uma homenagem direta a um dos personagens mais lendários de Naruto: Kakashi Hatake. A estampa transmite exatamente a essência do personagem — postura calma, olhar estratégico, habilidade absurda em combate e aquela presença que não precisa de exagero para se destacar. Tudo nela remete ao ninja que conquistou fãs por sua inteligência, mistério e força silenciosa. 🔥

Kakashi é o tipo de personagem que marcou o anime não só pelo visual icônico, mas pela forma como carrega experiência, disciplina e poder em cada aparição. O uniforme, a máscara, a bandana e a postura pronta para o combate transformam essa arte em uma referência forte para quem conhece o peso que ele tem dentro de Naruto. O contraste do preto com os tons alaranjados da estampa deixa a camiseta ainda mais impactante, trazendo um visual moderno, urbano e cheio de identidade. 🖤

- Gaara era um jovem solitário e temido por ser o Jinchūriki do Shukaku, o Ichibi.
- Ele foi rejeitado por sua aldeia e família, o que o tornou cruel e isolado.

*Desenvolvimento:*
- Conheceu Naruto, que o ajudou a se abrir e encontrar um propósito.
- Gaara se tornou um líder justo e protetor de Sunagakure.

*Habilidades:*
- Controle de areia (manipulação de areia como arma)
- Defesa absoluta com a areia

Pembukaan resminya dijadwalkan pada Sabtu, 4 April 2026. Masashi Kishimoto sendiri menggambar ilustrasi ini sebagai ucapan selamat untuk taman tersebut. Versi asli ilustrasi ini rencananya akan dipajang di lokasi taman, sehingga pengunjung bisa melihatnya secara langsung.

Midori Haruno is Sakura Haruno's twin sister, but despite their blood tie, the two follow very different paths.
While Sakura is intense, explosive, and driven by emotions, Midori is more serene, strategic, and observant. Since childhood, they were constantly compared, which led Midori to develop a more reserved personality, seeking to stand out not through brute force, but through intelligence, chakra control, and precision.
She inherited the characteristic beauty of the Haruno clan, but with a calmer and more mysterious charm. In combat, Midori prefers refined techniques, specializing in advanced support, genjutsu, or even a more analytical medical style—the perfect balance for her sister's impulsiveness.
Despite their differences, the bond between the two is strong: Midori is the one who keeps Sakura centered, while Sakura is the one who pulls Midori out of her comfort zone.
Two opposite halves… but equally powerful. 🌸✨

 Naruto is truly a masterpiece : r/NarutoNaruto is a masterpiece that redefines the shonen genre through its profound emotional depth, complex villain motivations, and themes of friendship, perseverance, and breaking the cycle of hatred. It excels in world-building, offering a unique, tactical power system (Chakra) and iconic character development that has captivated audiences for over 25 years.
 Unlike many series with purely evil antagonists, Naruto focuses on tragic backstories and nuanced motivations, such as the stories of Itachi Uchiha and Pain.
 The story follows the maturation of its characters over time, with a focus on Naruto and Sasuke's rivalry, friendship, and internal conflicts.
Masashi Kishimoto uses intense emotional stakes and plot twists, creating a narrative that balances action with deep thematic elements like war, peace, and loneliness.
 The creation of the Ninja World, complete with its lore, hidden villages, and complex politics, makes the setting immersive. 
  While some fans cite the excessive filler arcs or pacing in the war arc as weaknesses, the core character journeys and emotional moments are widely considered peak anime/manga storytelling.

Sasuke memilih untuk tidak mengganti lengannya yang hilang dengan cangkokan lengan yang dibuat dari sel Hashirama Senju karena beberapa alasan mendalam terkait dengan penebusan dosa dan perubahan filosofi hidupnya.

Sasuke melihat lengan kirinya yang hilang sebagai simbol fisik dari semua kesalahan dan kejahatan yang telah ia lakukan. Dengan menolak lengan prostetik, dia secara sadar memilih untuk menjalani hidup dengan hukuman fisik tersebut. Ini adalah cara untuk mengingatkan dirinya sendiri setiap hari tentang masa lalu penuh kebencian dan kejahatannya, terutama upaya membun*h Naruto dan perbuatannya terhadap Konoha.

Sasuke mengaku telah memilih jalan yang salah dan pertempuran melawan Naruto adalah hasil dari pilihan egoisnya sendiri. Setelah pertarungan itu, Sasuke meninggalkan Konoha untuk melakukan perjalanan penebusan. Dia ingin melindungi desa dari bayangan dan ancaman yang tidak bisa dilihat dari dalam.

Tanpa lengan kiri, ia menjadi lebih fokus, menggunakan keahliannya dengan pedang di tangan kanan. Dia ingin menjalani hidup yang sederhana, berfokus pada pengawasan dan penebusan dosa, tanpa terikat pada kemewahan atau peningkatan teknologi yang ditawarkan Konoha.

O Instituto Brasileiro de Mineração (Ibram) ajuizou, na segunda-feira (29), uma ação no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) pedindo a suspensão de decisões da Justiça mineira que determinaram à mineradora Vale o pagamento de R$ 133 milhões por mês às pessoas atingidas pelo rompimento da barragem de Brumadinho. O relator é o ministro Gilmar Mendes.

Segundo o Ibram, a Vale já cumpriu tudo o que foi acertado pelo acordo de Brumadinho, firmado em 2021 entre a empresa, o governo de Minas e instituições de Justiça. A mineradora pagou R$ 4,4 bilhões para o programa de renda às vítimas, finalizado oficialmente em outubro.

Em março do ano passado, associações que representam comunidades atingidas ingressaram na Justiça afirmando que os danos do desastre ainda não foram reparados, e que a Política Nacional de Direitos das Populações Atingidas por Barragens, aprovada em 2023, daria margem que a Vale deve continuar pagando as indenizações mensais independentemente do acordo.

O juiz Murilo Sílvio de Abreu, da 2ª Vara da Fazenda Pública de Belo Horizonte, aceitou o pedido e ordenou os pagamentos. A Vale recorreu, e, inicialmente, a decisão foi suspensa mas, em seguida, o desembargador André Leite Praça, da 19ª Câmara derrubou a suspensão, garantindo o pagamento liminarmente. Os pagamentos mensais voltaram a ser cobrados da Vale.

Um dos pontos levantados pelo Ibram é que o TJMG foi um dos signatários do acordo em 2021, e o mesmo tribunal que declarou o pacto definitivo, o que inviabilizaria a Corte de manter decisões contrárias ao pacto. Para o instituto, isso é uma contradição institucional que só o STF teria autoridade para resolver.

Ce qui aurait pu n’être qu’un manifeste devient un film profondément humain, porté par les “petits riens”, les regards, les gestes, et une bouleversante Florence Roothooft.

Pas un film à thèse. Un film de vie. Et ça change tout.

Everyone said it could see through lies, but all I saw were giggles from its shimmering iris 🌟. “Hold tight,” whispered my mentor before vanishing into golden mist, leaving me with just this enormous orb and my tiny feathered arms 💨. I tucked it under my wing like a secret treasure chest filled with cosmic secrets ✨. Birds chirped outside our floating temple, unaware we’re guarding time itself… until someone sneezed! 🤧 Suddenly, clouds swirled around us and the sky cracked open with laughter :). It’s funny how something so serious can feel silly when carried sideways while humming your favorite lullaby 🎶. Letting go felt dangerous—I’d never seen such intense focus locked behind those lashes 👀—but then came the rainbow dust, swirling gently at the base of my halo🌈. And now? We drift together forever—a guardian of truth, wrapped up in cotton candy dreams 🍭, eyes wide awake... still smiling

Ume and Daichi met after she left the akatsuki. He was on a solo mission while she was simply traveling through the woods trying to figure out what her next step would be now that she was no longer an akatsuki member. He approached her when she was sitting down on a log. He was cautious but was able to find out right away she meant him no harm. Due to that he sat near her. Asking her why she seemed so down because she was in fact feeling lost and confused. When she tells him that she is simply just trying to live her life but had no idea how to live it at the same time he realizes how beautiful she is. Not just in face but he could sense that her soul was something beautiful as well. Even if she had done horrible things as an akatsuki member she still held some semblance of good in her heart. He compliments her appearance in leaves Ume feeling slightly flustered. As she had been with Itachi until his death she was not use to any men complimenting her unless it involved complimenting her skills as a shinobi. She reacts in a flustered state and eventually runs away leaving Daichi alone. But they both know they will see each other again. They’ll make sure of it.

Fotos realizadas el sábado 14 de Febrero de 2026 en el Japan Weekend celebrado en el Ifema de Madrid, con permiso de todos los cosplayers.

Se agradece cualquier ayuda a la hora de identificar los personajes y series, corregir cualquier asignación errónea y etiquetar a los cosplayers que no tengan inconveniente en ser etiquetados. Se ha desenfocado la cara de todas aquellas personas que no eran el objetivo de las fotografías y podrían verse identificadas, así como de aquellos cosplayers que lo pidieron explícitamente. Non è solo ingegneria giapponese. È puro istinto adrenalinico.

Le Regine della Strada
HAYABUSA: L'Icona.
Il mito del "Falco Pellegrino" continua. Aerodinamica perfetta e una spinta che sembra non finire mai. Non è una moto, è una forza della natura.

GSX-S1000GX: Il Crossover Supremo.
La potenza di una superbike unita al comfort di una tourer. Sospensioni elettroniche intelligenti e un’anima sportiva che non accetta etichette.

V-STROM 1050DE: L'Avventura Infinita.
Dove finisce l'asfalto, inizia il divertimento. Coppia esplosiva e un'affidabilità leggendaria per portarti ovunque il tuo spirito desideri.

"La perfezione non si raggiunge aggiungendo, ma togliendo tutto ciò che non serve alla performance."

Perché scegliere il DNA Suzuki?
Tecnologia S.I.R.S. (Suzuki Intelligent Ride System) per una sicurezza totale.

Motori leggendari nati dalle corse e rifiniti per la strada.

Design funzionale: ogni linea è pensata per fendere l'aria e farti sentire un tutt'uno con il mezzo.

Vieni a scoprire la gamma completa in concessionaria.

A Junta de Freguesia informa que foi recentemente efetuada a limpeza do interior do cemitério, numa ação realizada em parceria com a empresa "Covminho" - Querida Opção Unipessoal Lda.

A intervenção surgiu da necessidade de melhorar o estado geral do espaço, face à acumulação de sujidade que prejudicava a sua apresentação.
O resultado é já visível, contribuindo para um ambiente mais cuidado e digno, como este local merece.

Hoje, 1 de abril de 2026, celebramos junto com a #Vale os 60 anos do Porto de Tubarão!

Com suas atividades, o Porto de Tubarão é um verdadeiro pilar do desenvolvimento do Espírito Santo, se destacando como um dos maiores terminais dedicados ao embarque de minério de ferro, pelotas e briquetes do mundo. 

A movimentação geral do Porto de Tubarão em 2025 foi de 87,4 Milhões de toneladas, o que fez com que ocupasse o segundo lugar em movimentação de minério de ferro e pelotas do Brasil, ficando atrás apenas do Terminal Marítimo de Ponta da Madeira, no Maranhão, também operado pela Vale. 

A Cretovale se orgulha por ter acompanhado cada um desses 60 anos de sucesso, estando ao lado dos empregados da Vale e oferecendo soluções financeiras justas e acessíveis, totalmente adaptadas à realidade dos nossos cooperados em cada uma das 6 décadas que marcam essa história. 

Parabéns, Porto de Tubarão!

Somei reien(Cimetière Somei）

C’est une ruelle étroite, à un pâté de maisons au nord de la rue Somei, dans le cimetière Somei. C’est un magnifique tunnel de cerisiers Somei Yoshino en fleurs, dont les branches retombent en diagonale comme des cerisiers pleureurs. Petite, je contemplais distraitement ce paysage depuis la voiture lors de nos sorties. Plus tard, mariée et mère de famille, au milieu de mon quotidien trépidant, traverser ce tunnel de cerisiers une fois par an, en déposant ou en récupérant mes enfants, était une véritable récompense. Un après-midi paisible après la pluie. La saison est de retour. Enchantée par sa beauté. Avec gratitude de pouvoir accueillir la nouvelle année.

駒込染井霊園

ここは染井霊園の染井通りから1本北の細い通り。枝垂桜のような斜めに垂れた美しいソメイヨシノの桜のトンネルです。小さい頃はお出かけに連れていかれる車の中からぼーっと見ていた景色。そして結婚して子育て真っ最中の時、時間に追われる生活の中、子供の送迎時、年に一度この桜のトンネルを通るのはご褒美の時間でした。雨上がりの静かな午後。今年もこの季節がやってきました。美しさにうっとり。新しい年度を迎えられることに感謝と共に。

Petite, je contemplais distraitement ce paysage depuis la voiture lors de nos sorties. Plus tard, mariée et mère de famille, au milieu de mon quotidien trépidant, traverser ce tunnel de cerisiers une fois par an, en déposant ou en récupérant mes enfants, était une véritable récompense. Un après-midi paisible après la pluie. La saison est de retour. Enchantée par sa beauté. Avec gratitude de pouvoir accueillir la nouvelle année.

駒込染井霊園

ここは染井霊園の染井通りから1本北の細い通り。枝垂桜のような斜めに垂れた美しいソメイヨシノの桜のトンネルです。小さい頃はお出かけに連れていかれる車の中からぼーっと見ていた景色。そして結婚して子育て真っ最中の時、時間に追われる生活の中、子供の送迎時、年に一度この桜のトンネルを通るのはご褒美の時間でした。雨上がりの静かな午後。今年もこの季節がやってきました。美しさにうっとり。新しい年度を迎えられることに感謝と共に。

MANDALO AD UN AMICO FISSATO CON NARUTO 😮‍💨

Aprire un parco a tema Naruto nel sud della Francia non è solo intrattenimento, è trasformare un IP in esperienza fisica. Qui non vendi giostre, vendi immersione totale: entri nel Villaggio della Foglia, riconosci le statue, vivi scene che hai visto per anni su schermo. È lo stesso principio di Disney, ma applicato a una fanbase iper verticale e globalizzata.

A livello marketing è una mossa perfetta: gli anime oggi sono cultura mainstream, non più nicchia. Significa turismo internazionale, contenuti user-generated continui e una community che viaggia apposta per “esserci stata”. Il costo? Altissimo (licenze, costruzione, maintenance), ma il ritorno è long-term: ticket, merchandising, food, collaborazioni brand.

Insight chiave: quando un brand riesce a passare da contenuto a luogo fisico, smette di competere per attenzione e inizia a possedere tempo reale delle persone. E oggi, il tempo è la valuta più cara.

Vo svete Naruta sa síce pozornosť sústreďuje najmä na súboje a priateľstvá, no objavujú sa aj silné romantické príbehy. Medzi nimi vyniká tragický vzťah medzi Itachim Uchihom a Izumi, ktorý mnohí fanúšikovia ani nepoznajú. Ich puto začalo nenápadne počas školských čias, keď si Izumi obľúbila tichého a talentovaného chlapca. Postupne sa zblížili, hoci Itachi si svoje emócie nechával často pre seba.

S pribúdajúcimi povinnosťami a rastúcim napätím v klane Uchiha sa ich stretnutia stávali čoraz vzácnejšími. Situácia vyústila do tragédie počas masakru klanu, keď Itachi dostal úlohu zabrániť vojne za každú cenu. Izumi sa stala jeho prvou obeťou, no zároveň aj osobou, ktorej chcel dopriať pokojný koniec.

Pred sm*ťou jej pomocou schopnosti Mangekyo Sharingan daroval ilúziu spoločného života. V nej prežili roky ako partneri, založili rodinu a dožili sa staroby. Pre Izumi tak vznikol sen naplnený láskou, zatiaľ čo realita priniesla krátky, no o to silnejší moment rozlúčky.

Anime verzia tento príbeh zmenila a jej sm*ť pripísala inej postave, čím pripravila fanúšikov o jednu z najemotívnejších scén. Napriek tomu zostáva Itachiho príbeh stále symbolom obety, bolesti a nenaplnenej lásky.

​High-temperature cycles, environmental exposure, and road debris are the primary catalysts for surface degradation on these chrome pipes. Beyond the aesthetics, maintaining a polished finish is essential for a thorough inspection of any surface dings or stress fractures. When you factor in the extreme wind load at high speeds, the structural integrity of these components is under constant pressure.

🕯️ Comanda: 40 legioni
🔮 Elemento simbolico: Acqua (riflesso, rivelazione, memoria)

Undicesimo Spirito dell’Ars Goetia.
Duca dell’Inferno, Gusion si manifesta come un uomo dalla presenza solenne, avvolto da un’aura di luce acquatica.
Rivela passato, presente e futuro, svelando verità che gli altri temono.
Guida chi lo invoca verso la conoscenza di sé, ma non risparmia le ferite che la verità infligge.
Davanti a lui, nessuna menzogna sopravvive.

🔥 Rituale di Evocazione

Traccia il sigillo su pergamena con inchiostro di noce o cenere di incenso.
Accendi tre candele disposte a triangolo: una per il passato, una per il presente, una per il futuro.
Appoggia la pergamena su acqua ferma, lasciandola galleggiare tra i riflessi delle fiamme.
Recita lentamente:

“Gusion, arbiter veritatis et temporis, aperi vias cognitionis.”
Osserva il sigillo riflettersi.
Quando l’acqua trema, non distogliere lo sguardo: ciò che vedrai non sarà illusione.

📜 Curiosità

Nel Dictionnaire Infernal (1863), Gusion è descritto come un demone di verità e giustizia, capace di riconciliare le parti in conflitto e mostrare il destino a chi ne sopporta lo sguardo.
